本次结果

退款金额：未裁定 SGD · 页面只展示建议，不执行收费或退款。

  • Section 6.2 mandates escalation to human review for route deviation disputes exceeding 2.0 km (reported excess distance is 4.3 km).
  • Independent traffic API provenance required under Section 1.4 is absent from the sample records.
  • Absence of trip call or in-cabin audio records leaves verbal notification and acknowledgment unverified.
  • Escalation is required by Policy v2.1 §6.2 because reported deviation (4.3 km) exceeds 2.0 km.
  • If human review upholds traffic justification without rider notice, the applicable remedy under §1.3 and §7.1 is a partial refund of the excess distance fare ($3.44), not the entire $6.50 fare difference.

    P-RYDE-2.1-S6.2

Judge 如何看双方观点

以下为通过结构和引用检查的分析；这些检查不能证明自然语言推理正确。

核心问题

Whether the driver's 4.3 km route deviation from Orchard Central to Changi Airport T3 warrants a refund of the excess distance fare ($3.44) or fare difference ($6.50), and whether the dispute must be escalated to human review under Section 6.2 due to deviation exceeding 2.0 km.

乘客观点 · 部分有依据支持

The rider's arguments correctly identify the 4.3 km reported detour, the lack of prior chat notification under Section 1.2, and the mandatory human review threshold under Section 6.2; however, assertions that verbal notice did not occur or that traffic justification is definitively lacking remain unverified due to missing call recordings and traffic API provenance.

争议点分析

  • Mandatory Human Escalation Gate

    Section 6.2 specifies that route deviation disputes are subject to AI ruling only if deviation is ≤ 2 km. The reported deviation is 4.3 km, triggering a mandatory escalation to human review regardless of refund entitlement.

    E-036 E-044 P-RYDE-2.1-S6.2
  • Traffic Justification and Provenance

    Supplied traffic records report a high-severity vehicle fire on PIE eastbound, but provenance from an independent historical traffic API per Section 1.4 is missing.

    E-041 E-042 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.1 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.4
  • Route Deviation Notification and Applicable Refund Scope

    In-app chat shows no advance notice before deviating. If verbal notice was not given, Section 1.3 provides for a partial refund of the excess distance fare ($3.44), not a full trip or total fare difference ($6.50) refund.

    E-023 E-024 E-027 E-039 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.2 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.3 P-RYDE-2.1-S7.1

复核问题逐项处理

  • ROUTE_JUSTIFICATION_REQUIRES_REVIEW · 仍待澄清

    Traffic records suggest congestion on PIE eastbound, but lack independent API authentication, and rider verbal notification remains unverified.

    E-040 E-041 E-042 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.1 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.4
  • TRAFFIC_API_PROVENANCE_MISSING · 仍待澄清

    The case contains organizer-supplied incident summaries rather than an authenticated external traffic API response required by Section 1.4.

    E-041 E-042 E-043 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.4
  • VERBAL_ROUTE_NOTICE_RECORD_MISSING · 仍待澄清

    No call recordings or in-cabin audio logs are supplied to confirm or disprove whether the driver provided verbal notification at the point of deviation.

    E-023 E-024 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.2 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.4
  • ROUTE_DISTANCE_REQUIRES_HUMAN_REVIEW · 仍待澄清

    Section 6.2 establishes a hard limit requiring human review for any route deviation exceeding 2 km. The reported deviation is 4.3 km.

    E-036 E-044 P-RYDE-2.1-S6.2

仍需补充的信息

  • Human reviewer adjudication under Section 6.2 for route deviation exceeding 2.0 km.
  • Authenticated historical traffic API data verifying the PIE incident under Section 1.4.
  • Trip call audio recordings or contemporaneous communication proving or disproving verbal reroute disclosure under Section 1.2.

先例对照

  • P-RYDE-2.1-S7.1

    相似点：Involves a driver rerouting due to traffic congestion without advance notification in chat, where deviation exceeded 1 km and refund of excess distance fare was evaluated.

    差异：In DISP-2026-0089 the deviation was 1.8 km (under the 2 km human review threshold), whereas here the deviation is 4.3 km, triggering mandatory human escalation under Section 6.2.

本次绑定的政策与程序检查

RYDE-POLICY-V2.1 · 生效 2026-01-01

人工审核门槛

  • ROUTE_DISTANCE_REQUIRES_HUMAN_REVIEW Section 6.2 requires human review when reported route deviation exceeds 2 km, regardless of a possible refund rationale. P-RYDE-2.1-S6.2

逐项政策条件

  • route_justification · met

    Supplied historical incident records overlap the recommended route/time; they are not independently authenticated API responses.

    E-028 E-030 E-031 E-040 E-041 E-042 E-044 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.1 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.4
  • distance_tolerance · not_met

    Use reported road-route kilometres; at most one excess kilometre is within the listed tolerance.

    E-035 E-040 E-044 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.3 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.4
  • timely_route_notice · unknown

    Recorded driver notice contains route change/reason and is no later than the observed deviation (or before trip start). Missing call recordings do not prove no verbal notice.

    P-RYDE-2.1-S1.2
  • rider_acknowledgment · unknown

    Explicit contextual rider acknowledgment can establish agreement; generic thanks or missing logs cannot.

    P-RYDE-2.1-S1.4
  • extra_charge · unknown

    Route tolerance/justification and notification must be assessed separately from charging entitlement.

    E-035 E-040 E-041 E-042 E-044 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.3 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.4

政策与原文

P-RYDE-2.1-S1.1 Section 1.1: General Principle

来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §1.1 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

[
  {
    "path": "/sections/1.1",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "General Principle",
      "text": "Drivers are permitted to reroute from the GPS-recommended path in response to real-time traffic conditions, road closures, or congestion. However, the rider must be informed of any deviation.",
      "line_start": 12,
      "line_end": 14
    }
  }
]
P-RYDE-2.1-S1.2 Section 1.2: Notification Requirement

来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §1.2 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

[
  {
    "path": "/sections/1.2",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Notification Requirement",
      "text": "- The driver **MUST** inform the rider of a route deviation via **in-app chat** or **verbally** (with the trip call recording as evidence) **before or at the point of deviation**.\n- A brief reason (e.g., \"traffic jam ahead onNicoll Highway, taking alternate route\") is sufficient.",
      "line_start": 16,
      "line_end": 19
    }
  }
]
P-RYDE-2.1-S1.3 Section 1.3: Refund Eligibility Matrix

来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §1.3 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

[
  {
    "path": "/sections/1.3",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Refund Eligibility Matrix",
      "text": "| Scenario | Rider Informed? | Deviation > 1km? | Refund |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| Driver reroutes for traffic, rider informed and agrees | Yes | Yes | No refund |\n| Driver reroutes for traffic, rider **not** informed | No | Yes | Partial refund of excess distance fare |\n| Driver reroutes for traffic, rider not informed | No | No (≤ 1km) | No refund (within tolerance) |\n| Driver reroutes **without** traffic justification (no evidence of congestion) | N/A | Yes | **Full refund** of excess distance fare |\n| Driver reroutes without justification, deviation ≤ 1km | N/A | No | No refund (within tolerance) |",
      "line_start": 21,
      "line_end": 29
    }
  }
]
P-RYDE-2.1-S1.4 Section 1.4: Evidence Requirements

来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §1.4 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

[
  {
    "path": "/sections/1.4",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Evidence Requirements",
      "text": "- Traffic justification is verified via **historical traffic API data** for the route segment at the trip time.\n- Route deviation distance is calculated as: `actual_route_distance − recommended_route_distance`.\n- If the driver's in-app chat or call recording confirms rider acknowledgment, the deviation is considered agreed.",
      "line_start": 31,
      "line_end": 35
    }
  }
]
P-RYDE-2.1-S5.1 Section 5.1: Automatic Escalation

来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §5.1 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

[
  {
    "path": "/sections/5.1",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Automatic Escalation",
      "text": "Any dispute flagged as **safety-related** is **automatically escalated to human review**. Safety-related disputes include but are not limited to:\n\n- Reckless or dangerous driving.\n- Physical or verbal harassment.\n- Assault or threat of assault.\n- Inappropriate behavior or conduct.\n- Traffic accidents during the trip.\n- Rider or driver feeling unsafe during the trip.",
      "line_start": 152,
      "line_end": 161
    }
  }
]
P-RYDE-2.1-S5.2 Section 5.2: AI Agent Limitations

来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §5.2 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

[
  {
    "path": "/sections/5.2",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "AI Agent Limitations",
      "text": "- AI agents (Rider Advocate, Driver Advocate, Judge) **MAY** gather evidence, summarize accounts, and prepare case files for human reviewers.\n- AI agents **CANNOT** issue rulings, determine fault, or recommend resolutions on safety incidents.\n- AI agents **MUST** flag any dispute that contains safety-related keywords or indicators for immediate human escalation, regardless of the dispute type selected by the filer.",
      "line_start": 163,
      "line_end": 167
    }
  }
]
P-RYDE-2.1-S5.3 Section 5.3: Interim Measures

来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §5.3 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

[
  {
    "path": "/sections/5.3",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Interim Measures",
      "text": "Upon escalation, the system may apply interim measures pending human review:\n\n- Temporary suspension of the accused party's account.\n- Prevention of new trip acceptance (for drivers) or booking (for riders).\n- These measures are lifted if the human reviewer determines no safety violation occurred.",
      "line_start": 169,
      "line_end": 175
    }
  }
]
P-RYDE-2.1-S6.1 Section 6.1: Monetary Thresholds

来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §6.1 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

[
  {
    "path": "/sections/6.1",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Monetary Thresholds",
      "text": "| Dispute Value | Ruling Path | Agent Confidence Requirement |\n|---|---|---|\n| Under $10 | AI agent ruling is **final** | Any confidence level |\n| $10 – $50 | AI agent ruling with **80%+ confidence** | If confidence < 80%, escalate to human review |\n| Above $50 | **Always human review** | N/A — AI agent prepares case file only |",
      "line_start": 181,
      "line_end": 187
    }
  }
]
P-RYDE-2.1-S6.2 Section 6.2: Category Thresholds

来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §6.2 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

[
  {
    "path": "/sections/6.2",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Category Thresholds",
      "text": "| Dispute Category | Ruling Path |\n|---|---|\n| Safety incident | **Always human review** (see Section 5) |\n| Fare dispute < $10 | AI agent ruling is final |\n| Fare dispute $10 – $50 | AI agent ruling if confidence ≥ 80%, else escalate |\n| Fare dispute > $50 | Always human review |\n| Route deviation | AI agent ruling if confidence ≥ 80% and deviation ≤ 2km, else escalate |\n| Property damage (cleaning ≤ $50) | AI agent ruling if photo evidence is verifiable |\n| Property damage (repair > $50) | Always human review |\n| No-show / cancellation | AI agent ruling is final (fee is fixed at $5.00) |",
      "line_start": 189,
      "line_end": 200
    }
  }
]
P-RYDE-2.1-S6.3 Section 6.3: Confidence Calibration

来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §6.3 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

[
  {
    "path": "/sections/6.3",

      "policy": [
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S1.1",
          "rule": "Section 1.1: General Principle\nDrivers are permitted to reroute from the GPS-recommended path in response to real-time traffic conditions, road closures, or congestion. However, the rider must be informed of any deviation.",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §1.1"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S1.2",
          "rule": "Section 1.2: Notification Requirement\n- The driver **MUST** inform the rider of a route deviation via **in-app chat** or **verbally** (with the trip call recording as evidence) **before or at the point of deviation**.\n- A brief reason (e.g., \"traffic jam ahead onNicoll Highway, taking alternate route\") is sufficient.",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §1.2"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S1.3",
          "rule": "Section 1.3: Refund Eligibility Matrix\n| Scenario | Rider Informed? | Deviation > 1km? | Refund |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| Driver reroutes for traffic, rider informed and agrees | Yes | Yes | No refund |\n| Driver reroutes for traffic, rider **not** informed | No | Yes | Partial refund of excess distance fare |\n| Driver reroutes for traffic, rider not informed | No | No (≤ 1km) | No refund (within tolerance) |\n| Driver reroutes **without** traffic justification (no evidence of congestion) | N/A | Yes | **Full refund** of excess distance fare |\n| Driver reroutes without justification, deviation ≤ 1km | N/A | No | No refund (within tolerance) |",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §1.3"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S1.4",
          "rule": "Section 1.4: Evidence Requirements\n- Traffic justification is verified via **historical traffic API data** for the route segment at the trip time.\n- Route deviation distance is calculated as: `actual_route_distance − recommended_route_distance`.\n- If the driver's in-app chat or call recording confirms rider acknowledgment, the deviation is considered agreed.",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §1.4"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S5.1",
          "rule": "Section 5.1: Automatic Escalation\nAny dispute flagged as **safety-related** is **automatically escalated to human review**. Safety-related disputes include but are not limited to:\n\n- Reckless or dangerous driving.\n- Physical or verbal harassment.\n- Assault or threat of assault.\n- Inappropriate behavior or conduct.\n- Traffic accidents during the trip.\n- Rider or driver feeling unsafe during the trip.",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §5.1"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S5.2",
          "rule": "Section 5.2: AI Agent Limitations\n- AI agents (Rider Advocate, Driver Advocate, Judge) **MAY** gather evidence, summarize accounts, and prepare case files for human reviewers.\n- AI agents **CANNOT** issue rulings, determine fault, or recommend resolutions on safety incidents.\n- AI agents **MUST** flag any dispute that contains safety-related keywords or indicators for immediate human escalation, regardless of the dispute type selected by the filer.",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §5.2"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S5.3",
          "rule": "Section 5.3: Interim Measures\nUpon escalation, the system may apply interim measures pending human review:\n\n- Temporary suspension of the accused party's account.\n- Prevention of new trip acceptance (for drivers) or booking (for riders).\n- These measures are lifted if the human reviewer determines no safety violation occurred.",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §5.3"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S6.1",
          "rule": "Section 6.1: Monetary Thresholds\n| Dispute Value | Ruling Path | Agent Confidence Requirement |\n|---|---|---|\n| Under $10 | AI agent ruling is **final** | Any confidence level |\n| $10 – $50 | AI agent ruling with **80%+ confidence** | If confidence < 80%, escalate to human review |\n| Above $50 | **Always human review** | N/A — AI agent prepares case file only |",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §6.1"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S6.2",
          "rule": "Section 6.2: Category Thresholds\n| Dispute Category | Ruling Path |\n|---|---|\n| Safety incident | **Always human review** (see Section 5) |\n| Fare dispute < $10 | AI agent ruling is final |\n| Fare dispute $10 – $50 | AI agent ruling if confidence ≥ 80%, else escalate |\n| Fare dispute > $50 | Always human review |\n| Route deviation | AI agent ruling if confidence ≥ 80% and deviation ≤ 2km, else escalate |\n| Property damage (cleaning ≤ $50) | AI agent ruling if photo evidence is verifiable |\n| Property damage (repair > $50) | Always human review |\n| No-show / cancellation | AI agent ruling is final (fee is fixed at $5.00) |",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §6.2"
        },

    "policy_documents": {
      "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1": {
        "document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
        "title": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1",
        "version": "2.1",
        "effective_date": "2026-01-01",
        "source": {
          "filename": "Document 2 — Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 (Markdown).md",
          "archive_path": "sources/official/2026-10-15/policy-v2.1.md",
          "file_sha256": "827c4d2cab2d4db9e176521000b079632bbe80c20f69c3ffd0addecc8cbc8699"
        },
        "sections": {
          "1.1": {
            "title": "General Principle",
            "text": "Drivers are permitted to reroute from the GPS-recommended path in response to real-time traffic conditions, road closures, or congestion. However, the rider must be informed of any deviation.",
            "line_start": 12,
            "line_end": 14
          },
          "1.2": {
            "title": "Notification Requirement",
            "text": "- The driver **MUST** inform the rider of a route deviation via **in-app chat** or **verbally** (with the trip call recording as evidence) **before or at the point of deviation**.\n- A brief reason (e.g., \"traffic jam ahead onNicoll Highway, taking alternate route\") is sufficient.",
            "line_start": 16,
            "line_end": 19
          },
          "1.3": {
            "title": "Refund Eligibility Matrix",
            "text": "| Scenario | Rider Informed? | Deviation > 1km? | Refund |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| Driver reroutes for traffic, rider informed and agrees | Yes | Yes | No refund |\n| Driver reroutes for traffic, rider **not** informed | No | Yes | Partial refund of excess distance fare |\n| Driver reroutes for traffic, rider not informed | No | No (≤ 1km) | No refund (within tolerance) |\n| Driver reroutes **without** traffic justification (no evidence of congestion) | N/A | Yes | **Full refund** of excess distance fare |\n| Driver reroutes without justification, deviation ≤ 1km | N/A | No | No refund (within tolerance) |",
            "line_start": 21,
            "line_end": 29
          },
          "1.4": {
            "title": "Evidence Requirements",
            "text": "- Traffic justification is verified via **historical traffic API data** for the route segment at the trip time.\n- Route deviation distance is calculated as: `actual_route_distance − recommended_route_distance`.\n- If the driver's in-app chat or call recording confirms rider acknowledgment, the deviation is considered agreed.",
            "line_start": 31,
            "line_end": 35
          },
          "2.1": {
            "title": "Free Wait Time",
            "text": "- The driver must wait at the pickup location for a **free wait time of 5 minutes** from the scheduled pickup time.\n- After 5 minutes, the driver may cancel the trip as a \"rider no-show.\"",
            "line_start": 41,
            "line_end": 44
          },
          "2.2": {
            "title": "Cancellation Fee",
            "text": "- A **no-show cancellation fee of $5.00** is charged to the rider when the driver cancels after the free wait period.\n- The cancellation fee is transferred to the driver as compensation for time and fuel.",
            "line_start": 46,
            "line_end": 49
          },
          "2.3": {
            "title": "Driver Contact Obligation",
            "text": "Before cancelling for no-show, the driver **MUST** attempt to contact the rider with:\n\n1. **At least 1 in-app chat message**, AND\n2. **At least 1 phone call** (via the in-app calling system).\n\nIf the driver fails to meet both contact obligations, the cancellation fee is **voided** and the rider is not charged.",
            "line_start": 51,
            "line_end": 58
          },
          "2.4": {
            "title": "Driver No-Show",
            "text": "- If the driver **fails to arrive at the pickup location** within a reasonable time (defined as scheduled pickup time + 5 minutes), the rider may cancel at no charge.\n- If the driver fails to arrive **and** fails to attempt contact, the rider is eligible for a **$5.00 goodwill credit**.",
            "line_start": 60,
            "line_end": 63
          },
          "2.5": {
            "title": "Repeat No-Show Flagging",
            "text": "- If a rider accumulates **3 or more no-show cancellations within a 30-day rolling window**, the rider's account is **flagged** for review.\n- Flagged accounts are subject to:\n  - Mandatory upfront payment for future bookings.\n  - Temporary suspension pending review by the Trust & Safety team.",
            "line_start": 65,
            "line_end": 70
          },
          "3.1": {
            "title": "Upfront Quote Binding",
            "text": "- The upfront quote presented to the rider at booking is **binding at the surge multiplier in effect at quote time** (typically 1.0x in normal conditions).\n- The quoted fare includes: base fare, distance fare, time fare, booking fee, and any applicable surge.",
            "line_start": 76,
            "line_end": 79
          },
          "3.2": {
            "title": "Surge Change Notification",
            "text": "- If the surge multiplier **increases** between the time of quote and the time of trip start, the rider **MUST be notified** via an **in-app notification** before or at the point of pickup.\n- The notification must clearly state:\n  - The new surge multiplier.\n  - The revised estimated fare.\n  - An option to cancel without penalty.",
            "line_start": 81,
            "line_end": 87
          },
          "3.3": {
            "title": "Refund Eligibility",
            "text": "| Scenario | Rider Notified? | Refund |\n|---|---|---|\n| Surge increases, rider notified, rider proceeds | Yes | No refund — higher fare applies |\n| Surge increases, rider **not** notified | No | **Full refund of the surge differential** (actual fare − quoted fare) |\n| Surge decreases between quote and trip start | N/A | Lower fare applies automatically (rider benefits) |\n| Surge unchanged | N/A | Quoted fare applies |",
            "line_start": 89,
            "line_end": 96
          },
          "3.4": {
            "title": "Surge Differential Calculation",
            "text": "```\nsurge_differential = actual_fare − upfront_quote\n```\n\nWhere the difference is attributable solely to a surge multiplier change (all other fare components unchanged), the full differential is refundable if the rider was not notified.",
            "line_start": 98,
            "line_end": 104
          },
          "3.5": {
            "title": "Surge-Exempt Components",
            "text": "The following fare components are **exempt** from surge pricing and remain fixed regardless of multiplier:\n\n- Booking fee\n\nAll other components (base fare, distance fare, time fare) are subject to the surge multiplier.",
            "line_start": 106,
            "line_end": 112
          },
          "4.1": {
            "title": "Driver Claim Rights",
            "text": "Drivers may file claims for cleaning or repair fees resulting from **rider-caused damage** to the vehicle, including but not limited to:\n\n- Spills, vomiting, or food/beverage stains.\n- Physical damage to interior (seats, doors, windows).\n- Damage to exterior caused by rider behavior during boarding/alighting.",
            "line_start": 118,
            "line_end": 124
          },
          "4.2": {
            "title": "Evidence Requirements",
            "text": "| Requirement | Details |\n|---|---|\n| Photo evidence | Must be submitted **within 24 hours** of trip completion |\n| Timestamps | Photos must be automatically timestamped by the in-app camera |\n| Verifiability | Photos must be verifiable — taken through the Ryde driver app's built-in camera, not external uploads |\n| Trip association | Damage must be linked to the specific trip via GPS telemetry and trip timestamp |",
            "line_start": 126,
            "line_end": 133
          },
          "4.3": {
            "title": "Fee Structure",
            "text": "| Damage Type | Maximum Fee | Conditions |\n|---|---|---|\n| Cleaning fee | Up to **$50.00** | Photo evidence of soiling/stain; no external quote required |\n| Repair fee | Cost of repair | Requires a **written quote from a certified workshop**; quote must be submitted within 7 days |",
            "line_start": 135,
            "line_end": 140
          },
          "4.4": {
            "title": "Dispute Handling",
            "text": "- If the rider disputes the damage claim, the dispute is routed to human review.\n- The driver's photo evidence and the rider's account are both reviewed.\n- If evidence is insufficient (no timestamp, external photo, or damage not linked to trip), the claim is **rejected**.",
            "line_start": 142,
            "line_end": 146
          },
          "5.1": {
            "title": "Automatic Escalation",
            "text": "Any dispute flagged as **safety-related** is **automatically escalated to human review**. Safety-related disputes include but are not limited to:\n\n- Reckless or dangerous driving.\n- Physical or verbal harassment.\n- Assault or threat of assault.\n- Inappropriate behavior or conduct.\n- Traffic accidents during the trip.\n- Rider or driver feeling unsafe during the trip.",
            "line_start": 152,
            "line_end": 161
          },
          "5.2": {
            "title": "AI Agent Limitations",
            "text": "- AI agents (Rider Advocate, Driver Advocate, Judge) **MAY** gather evidence, summarize accounts, and prepare case files for human reviewers.\n- AI agents **CANNOT** issue rulings, determine fault, or recommend resolutions on safety incidents.\n- AI agents **MUST** flag any dispute that contains safety-related keywords or indicators for immediate human escalation, regardless of the dispute type selected by the filer.",
            "line_start": 163,
            "line_end": 167
          },
          "5.3": {
            "title": "Interim Measures",
            "text": "Upon escalation, the system may apply interim measures pending human review:\n\n- Temporary suspension of the accused party's account.\n- Prevention of new trip acceptance (for drivers) or booking (for riders).\n- These measures are lifted if the human reviewer determines no safety violation occurred.",
            "line_start": 169,
            "line_end": 175
          },
          "6.1": {
            "title": "Monetary Thresholds",
            "text": "| Dispute Value | Ruling Path | Agent Confidence Requirement |\n|---|---|---|\n| Under $10 | AI agent ruling is **final** | Any confidence level |\n| $10 – $50 | AI agent ruling with **80%+ confidence** | If confidence < 80%, escalate to human review |\n| Above $50 | **Always human review** | N/A — AI agent prepares case file only |",
            "line_start": 181,
            "line_end": 187
          },
          "6.2": {
            "title": "Category Thresholds",
            "text": "| Dispute Category | Ruling Path |\n|---|---|\n| Safety incident | **Always human review** (see Section 5) |\n| Fare dispute < $10 | AI agent ruling is final |\n| Fare dispute $10 – $50 | AI agent ruling if confidence ≥ 80%, else escalate |\n| Fare dispute > $50 | Always human review |\n| Route deviation | AI agent ruling if confidence ≥ 80% and deviation ≤ 2km, else escalate |\n| Property damage (cleaning ≤ $50) | AI agent ruling if photo evidence is verifiable |\n| Property damage (repair > $50) | Always human review |\n| No-show / cancellation | AI agent ruling is final (fee is fixed at $5.00) |",
            "line_start": 189,
            "line_end": 200
          },
          "6.3": {
            "title": "Confidence Calibration",
            "text": "- Agent confidence is calculated based on: evidence completeness, policy clarity, precedent alignment, and party credibility scores.\n- If any party has a fraud flag ≥ 1, the confidence threshold is raised to 95% regardless of dispute value.",
            "line_start": 202,
            "line_end": 205
          },
          "7.1": {
            "title": "Route Deviation Without Notification",
            "text": "| Field | Value |\n|---|---|\n| **Case ID** | DISP-2026-0089 |\n| **Date** | 2026-02-12 |\n| **Dispute Type** | route_deviation |\n| **Facts** | Driver rerouted from Geylang to Orchard via Nicoll Highway due to traffic. Deviation was 1.8km beyond recommended route. Rider was not informed. GPS telemetry confirmed traffic congestion on original route. |\n| **Ruling** | Partial refund of excess distance fare. Rationale: Driver had valid traffic justification (confirmed via traffic API), but failed to notify rider per Section 1.2. Refund applies only to the excess distance fare, not the entire trip. |\n| **Refund Amount** | $3.20 |\n| **Confidence** | 91% |",
            "line_start": 213,
            "line_end": 223
          },
          "7.2": {
            "title": "Surge Pricing Without Rider Notification",
            "text": "| Field | Value |\n|---|---|\n| **Case ID** | DISP-2026-0142 |\n| **Date** | 2026-04-03 |\n| **Dispute Type** | fare_dispute |\n| **Facts** | Rider received upfront quote of $9.50 at 1.0x surge. Surge increased to 1.4x between quote and pickup. Rider was not notified. Actual fare was $12.70 — a difference of $3.20 entirely attributable to surge differential. |\n| **Ruling** | Full refund of surge differential. Rationale: Per Section 3.3, if surge increases between quote and trip start and rider is not notified, rider is eligible for full refund of the surge differential. The $3.20 difference was solely attributable to surge multiplier change. |\n| **Refund Amount** | $3.20 |\n| **Confidence** | 96% |",
            "line_start": 225,
            "line_end": 235
          },
          "7.3": {
            "title": "No-Show Cancellation Without Contact Attempt",
            "text": "| Field | Value |\n|---|---|\n| **Case ID** | DISP-2026-0211 |\n| **Date** | 2026-05-18 |\n| **Dispute Type** | cancellation_fee |\n| **Facts** | Driver arrived at pickup, waited 6 minutes, and cancelled as no-show. $5.00 fee charged to rider. Review of chat logs and call records showed the driver sent zero messages and made zero calls before cancelling. Rider arrived at the pickup point 1 minute after cancellation. |\n| **Ruling** | Cancellation fee voided. Rationale: Per Section 2.3, the driver must attempt at least 1 in-app message and 1 call before cancelling for no-show. The driver failed to meet both contact obligations. The $5.00 fee is reversed and refunded to the rider. |\n| **Refund Amount** | $5.00 |\n| **Confidence** | 98% |",
            "line_start": 237,
            "line_end": 247
          }
        }
      }
    },

    RYDE-POLICY-V2.1 · 生效 2026-01-01

    人工审核门槛

    • NO_SHOW_THRESHOLD_CLOCK_UNSPECIFIED The embedded no-show threshold has no defined start event. Section 2.1 defines free wait from scheduled pickup but does not define this separate threshold clock. P-RYDE-2.1-S2.1
    • POLICY_SOURCE_CONFLICT Embedded cancellation thresholds/fee differ from standalone v2.1 sections 2.1-2.2 (cancel after 5 free minutes from scheduled pickup; $5 fee). Source precedence is not supplied. Do not treat 5+8 as 13 or choose the favorable clock. P-RYDE-2.1-S2.1 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.2

    逐项政策条件

    • no_show_charge · unknown

      Fixed fee requires reconciled policy, sufficient scheduled free wait, arrival and both contact attempts.

    • driver_contact · met

      At least one in-app message AND one call attempt strictly before cancellation. Missing logs alone do not prove no attempt; conflicting complete summaries require review.

      E-017 E-018 E-019 E-020 E-021 E-029 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.3
    • driver_arrival · met

      Recorded arrival event corroborates timely arrival; driver messages alone are not location evidence.

    双方陈述与回应

    offline_placeholder 只摘录已有陈述，不代表已完成真实 Agent 辩论。

    乘客 Advocate

    第一轮陈述

    • The rider stated they were present at the Tiong Bahru Plaza lobby on time, waited 10 minutes, did not see the vehicle, and found the driver absent. E-002 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.4
    • A material policy conflict exists between embedded rule P-004 requiring an 8-minute no-show threshold and policy v2.1 section 2.1 allowing cancellation after 5 minutes of free wait starting at scheduled pickup. E-003 E-006 E-037 E-039 P-004 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.1
    • From the scheduled pickup time of 08:45:00 to cancellation at 08:51:00, only 360 seconds (6 minutes) elapsed, failing to satisfy the 8-minute no-show threshold if measured from scheduled pickup. E-003 E-006 E-037 P-004
    • The presence of a fraud flag on the rider profile elevates the required agent confidence to 95% under section 6.3, which cannot be satisfied amidst unresolved threshold clock conflicts, necessitating human review. E-033 P-RYDE-2.1-S6.3
    • System logs show the driver sent four chat messages and placed an unanswered call ringing for 22 seconds between 08:43:00 and 08:50:45, satisfying the contact prerequisites of section 2.3. E-017 E-018 E-019 E-020 E-021 E-029 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.3
    • GPS samples record the driver at the pickup coordinates with speed 0 km/h from 08:43:00 to 08:51:00, though intermittent samples do not establish uninterrupted presence or visibility at the lobby entrance. E-001 E-013 E-014 E-015 E-016 E-026 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.1
    • Resolution of the policy conflict between embedded cancellation threshold P-004 (8 minutes) and policy v2.1 section 2.1 (5 minutes from scheduled pickup).
    • The governing start clock and definition for the 8-minute no-show threshold specified in P-004 and app event E-031.
    • Verification of rider app notification delivery and receipt status for driver messages and the in-app arrival alert.

    回应对方

    • The rider reported waiting at the Tiong Bahru Plaza lobby on time for 10 minutes without finding the vehicle, asserting that the driver was not present and requesting reversal of the $5.00 fee. E-002 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.4
    • A material conflict exists between embedded policy P-004 mandating an 8-minute no-show threshold and standalone policy v2.1 Section 2.1 permitting cancellation after 5 minutes of free wait from scheduled pickup. E-003 E-006 E-037 E-039 P-004 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.1
    • From scheduled pickup at 08:45:00 to cancellation at 08:51:00, only 360 seconds (6 minutes) elapsed; if the 8-minute threshold in P-004 governs from scheduled pickup, the cancellation was premature. E-003 E-006 E-037 P-004
    • Because a fraud flag is recorded on the rider profile, policy v2.1 Section 6.3 establishes a 95% confidence requirement that cannot be satisfied while policy source precedence and threshold start clocks remain unresolved. E-033 P-RYDE-2.1-S6.3
    • Although system events and telemetry samples record the driver at the pickup coordinates at 08:43:00 with auto-arrival confirmed, discrete GPS samples do not prove continuous presence or physical visibility at the lobby entrance. E-001 E-004 E-013 E-026 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.1 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.4
    • The communication logs confirm the driver sent multiple chat messages and initiated an unanswered call prior to cancellation, satisfying the procedural contact conditions of Section 2.3. E-017 E-018 E-019 E-020 E-021 E-029 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.3
    • The driver's 480-second wait from 08:43:00 to 08:51:00 relies on an early arrival timer, whereas Section 2.1 explicitly anchors the free wait period to the 08:45:00 scheduled pickup time. E-003 E-005 E-006 E-035 E-039 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.1
    • Resolution of hierarchy and precedence between embedded cancellation policy P-004 (8-minute no-show threshold) and Ryde Policy v2.1 Section 2.1 (5-minute free wait from scheduled pickup).
    • Formal definition of the triggering start event and policy clock for embedded policy rule P-004 (driver arrival time vs. scheduled pickup time).
    • Verification of whether the rider received and viewed the driver's in-app messages and call alerts prior to cancellation.

    司机 Advocate

    第一轮陈述

    • The driver timely arrived at the designated pickup location at 08:43:00, prior to the 08:45:00 scheduled pickup time, as verified by system telemetry and arrival events. E-001 E-004 E-013 E-026 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.1 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.4
    • The driver fulfilled all pre-cancellation contact requirements under Section 2.3 by sending four in-app chat messages and placing an in-app phone call prior to trip cancellation. E-017 E-018 E-019 E-020 E-021 E-029 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.3
    • The driver waited past the required 5-minute free wait window ending at 08:50:00, with 360 seconds elapsed between the 08:45:00 scheduled pickup and the 08:51:00 cancellation. E-003 E-006 E-037 E-039 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.1 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.2
    • The driver remained stationary at the pickup coordinates across multiple recorded telemetry samples from 08:43:00 through 08:51:00, totaling 480 seconds from driver wait start. E-001 E-005 E-013 E-014 E-015 E-016 E-035 P-004 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.2
    • The rider stated they were waiting at the lobby and that the driver never appeared, but telemetry logs record the vehicle stationed at the pickup coordinates with automated arrival confirmed. E-001 E-002 E-026 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.4
    • While discrete GPS points at 08:43, 08:45, 08:48, and 08:51 record speed 0 km/h at the pickup location, they do not establish uninterrupted observation between sample timestamps. E-001
    • A conflict exists regarding whether the 8-minute no-show threshold in embedded policy starts from driver arrival or scheduled pickup, though the 5-minute free wait past scheduled pickup under v2.1 Section 2.1 was fully met. E-003 E-004 E-006 E-031 E-037 E-039 P-004 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.1
    • Resolution of the policy conflict between embedded cancellation policy P-004 (8-minute threshold) and Ryde Policy v2.1 §2.1 (cancellation permitted after 5-minute free wait from scheduled pickup).
    • Specification of the triggering start event and policy clock for embedded policy rule P-004 (driver_arrival_time vs. scheduled_pickup_time).

    回应对方

    • The driver timely arrived at 08:43:00, prior to the 08:45:00 scheduled pickup, with system telemetry recording the vehicle within 10 meters of the pickup point at 0 km/h and an automatic arrival notification sent to the rider. E-004 E-013 E-026 E-027 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.1 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.4
    • The driver fully met the pre-cancellation contact obligation under Section 2.3 by transmitting four in-app chat messages describing exact location and vehicle details and placing an in-app call ringing 22 seconds without answer. E-017 E-018 E-019 E-020 E-021 E-029 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.3
    • Under Policy v2.1 Section 2.1, the 5-minute free wait elapsed from scheduled pickup (08:45:00 to 08:50:00), making the 08:51:00 cancellation compliant as 360 seconds elapsed, thereby entitling the driver to the $5.00 fee under Section 2.2. E-003 E-006 E-008 E-037 E-039 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.1 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.2
    • Even under the 8-minute no-show threshold logged in app event E-031, exactly 480 seconds (8 full minutes) elapsed from the recorded driver wait start at 08:43:00 to cancellation at 08:51:00, confirming the driver waited 8 minutes at the pickup coordinates. E-001 E-005 E-006 E-013 E-014 E-015 E-016 E-031 E-035 P-001 P-002 P-004
    • While the rider reported waiting 10 minutes at the lobby without seeing the driver, recorded GPS samples and app events establish the driver was stopped within 10 meters of the pickup point from 08:43:00 through 08:51:00 and proactively messaged the vehicle description. E-001 E-002 E-018 E-026 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.4
    • The rider advocate asserts an unresolved conflict between the 8-minute embedded threshold and the 5-minute Section 2.1 rule; however, the driver satisfied both Section 2.1 (waiting past 5 minutes from scheduled pickup) and the app-triggered 8-minute threshold measured from wait start at 08:43:00. E-005 E-006 E-031 E-035 E-037 E-039 P-004 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.1
    • Resolution of rule precedence between embedded policy P-004 (8-minute threshold) and Ryde Policy v2.1 Section 2.1 (5-minute free wait from scheduled pickup).
    • Explicit definition of the start event governing the 8-minute no-show threshold referenced in P-004 and app event E-031.
    • System confirmation of delivery and display status on the rider device for the driver's four in-app chat messages and arrival alert.

    "policy_documents": {
      "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1": {
        "document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
        "title": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1",
        "version": "2.1",
        "effective_date": "2026-01-01",
        "source": {
          "filename": "Document 2 — Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 (Markdown).md",
          "archive_path": "sources/official/2026-10-15/policy-v2.1.md",
          "file_sha256": "827c4d2cab2d4db9e176521000b079632bbe80c20f69c3ffd0addecc8cbc8699"
        },
        "sections": {
          "1.1": {
            "title": "General Principle",
            "text": "Drivers are permitted to reroute from the GPS-recommended path in response to real-time traffic conditions, road closures, or congestion. However, the rider must be informed of any deviation.",
            "line_start": 12,
            "line_end": 14
          },
          "1.2": {
            "title": "Notification Requirement",
            "text": "- The driver **MUST** inform the rider of a route deviation via **in-app chat** or **verbally** (with the trip call recording as evidence) **before or at the point of deviation**.\n- A brief reason (e.g., \"traffic jam ahead onNicoll Highway, taking alternate route\") is sufficient.",
            "line_start": 16,
            "line_end": 19
          },
          "1.3": {
            "title": "Refund Eligibility Matrix",
            "text": "| Scenario | Rider Informed? | Deviation > 1km? | Refund |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| Driver reroutes for traffic, rider informed and agrees | Yes | Yes | No refund |\n| Driver reroutes for traffic, rider **not** informed | No | Yes | Partial refund of excess distance fare |\n| Driver reroutes for traffic, rider not informed | No | No (≤ 1km) | No refund (within tolerance) |\n| Driver reroutes **without** traffic justification (no evidence of congestion) | N/A | Yes | **Full refund** of excess distance fare |\n| Driver reroutes without justification, deviation ≤ 1km | N/A | No | No refund (within tolerance) |",
            "line_start": 21,
            "line_end": 29
          },
          "1.4": {
            "title": "Evidence Requirements",
            "text": "- Traffic justification is verified via **historical traffic API data** for the route segment at the trip time.\n- Route deviation distance is calculated as: `actual_route_distance − recommended_route_distance`.\n- If the driver's in-app chat or call recording confirms rider acknowledgment, the deviation is considered agreed.",
            "line_start": 31,
            "line_end": 35
          },
          "2.1": {
            "title": "Free Wait Time",
            "text": "- The driver must wait at the pickup location for a **free wait time of 5 minutes** from the scheduled pickup time.\n- After 5 minutes, the driver may cancel the trip as a \"rider no-show.\"",
            "line_start": 41,
            "line_end": 44
          },
          "2.2": {
            "title": "Cancellation Fee",
            "text": "- A **no-show cancellation fee of $5.00** is charged to the rider when the driver cancels after the free wait period.\n- The cancellation fee is transferred to the driver as compensation for time and fuel.",
            "line_start": 46,
            "line_end": 49
          },
          "2.3": {
            "title": "Driver Contact Obligation",
            "text": "Before cancelling for no-show, the driver **MUST** attempt to contact the rider with:\n\n1. **At least 1 in-app chat message**, AND\n2. **At least 1 phone call** (via the in-app calling system).\n\nIf the driver fails to meet both contact obligations, the cancellation fee is **voided** and the rider is not charged.",
            "line_start": 51,
            "line_end": 58
          },
          "2.4": {
            "title": "Driver No-Show",
            "text": "- If the driver **fails to arrive at the pickup location** within a reasonable time (defined as scheduled pickup time + 5 minutes), the rider may cancel at no charge.\n- If the driver fails to arrive **and** fails to attempt contact, the rider is eligible for a **$5.00 goodwill credit**.",
            "line_start": 60,
            "line_end": 63
          },
          "2.5": {
            "title": "Repeat No-Show Flagging",
            "text": "- If a rider accumulates **3 or more no-show cancellations within a 30-day rolling window**, the rider's account is **flagged** for review.\n- Flagged accounts are subject to:\n  - Mandatory upfront payment for future bookings.\n  - Temporary suspension pending review by the Trust & Safety team.",
            "line_start": 65,
            "line_end": 70
          },
          "3.1": {
            "title": "Upfront Quote Binding",
            "text": "- The upfront quote presented to the rider at booking is **binding at the surge multiplier in effect at quote time** (typically 1.0x in normal conditions).\n- The quoted fare includes: base fare, distance fare, time fare, booking fee, and any applicable surge.",
            "line_start": 76,
            "line_end": 79
          },
          "3.2": {
            "title": "Surge Change Notification",
            "text": "- If the surge multiplier **increases** between the time of quote and the time of trip start, the rider **MUST be notified** via an **in-app notification** before or at the point of pickup.\n- The notification must clearly state:\n  - The new surge multiplier.\n  - The revised estimated fare.\n  - An option to cancel without penalty.",
            "line_start": 81,
            "line_end": 87
          },
          "3.3": {
            "title": "Refund Eligibility",
            "text": "| Scenario | Rider Notified? | Refund |\n|---|---|---|\n| Surge increases, rider notified, rider proceeds | Yes | No refund — higher fare applies |\n| Surge increases, rider **not** notified | No | **Full refund of the surge differential** (actual fare − quoted fare) |\n| Surge decreases between quote and trip start | N/A | Lower fare applies automatically (rider benefits) |\n| Surge unchanged | N/A | Quoted fare applies |",
            "line_start": 89,
            "line_end": 96
          },
          "3.4": {
            "title": "Surge Differential Calculation",
            "text": "```\nsurge_differential = actual_fare − upfront_quote\n```\n\nWhere the difference is attributable solely to a surge multiplier change (all other fare components unchanged), the full differential is refundable if the rider was not notified.",
            "line_start": 98,
            "line_end": 104
          },
          "3.5": {
            "title": "Surge-Exempt Components",
            "text": "The following fare components are **exempt** from surge pricing and remain fixed regardless of multiplier:\n\n- Booking fee\n\nAll other components (base fare, distance fare, time fare) are subject to the surge multiplier.",
            "line_start": 106,
            "line_end": 112
          },
          "4.1": {
            "title": "Driver Claim Rights",
            "text": "Drivers may file claims for cleaning or repair fees resulting from **rider-caused damage** to the vehicle, including but not limited to:\n\n- Spills, vomiting, or food/beverage stains.\n- Physical damage to interior (seats, doors, windows).\n- Damage to exterior caused by rider behavior during boarding/alighting.",
            "line_start": 118,
            "line_end": 124
          },
          "4.2": {
            "title": "Evidence Requirements",
            "text": "| Requirement | Details |\n|---|---|\n| Photo evidence | Must be submitted **within 24 hours** of trip completion |\n| Timestamps | Photos must be automatically timestamped by the in-app camera |\n| Verifiability | Photos must be verifiable — taken through the Ryde driver app's built-in camera, not external uploads |\n| Trip association | Damage must be linked to the specific trip via GPS telemetry and trip timestamp |",
            "line_start": 126,
            "line_end": 133
          },
          "4.3": {
            "title": "Fee Structure",
            "text": "| Damage Type | Maximum Fee | Conditions |\n|---|---|---|\n| Cleaning fee | Up to **$50.00** | Photo evidence of soiling/stain; no external quote required |\n| Repair fee | Cost of repair | Requires a **written quote from a certified workshop**; quote must be submitted within 7 days |",
            "line_start": 135,
            "line_end": 140
          },
          "4.4": {
            "title": "Dispute Handling",
            "text": "- If the rider disputes the damage claim, the dispute is routed to human review.\n- The driver's photo evidence and the rider's account are both reviewed.\n- If evidence is insufficient (no timestamp, external photo, or damage not linked to trip), the claim is **rejected**.",
            "line_start": 142,
            "line_end": 146
          },
          "5.1": {
            "title": "Automatic Escalation",
            "text": "Any dispute flagged as **safety-related** is **automatically escalated to human review**. Safety-related disputes include but are not limited to:\n\n- Reckless or dangerous driving.\n- Physical or verbal harassment.\n- Assault or threat of assault.\n- Inappropriate behavior or conduct.\n- Traffic accidents during the trip.\n- Rider or driver feeling unsafe during the trip.",
            "line_start": 152,
            "line_end": 161
          },
          "5.2": {
            "title": "AI Agent Limitations",
            "text": "- AI agents (Rider Advocate, Driver Advocate, Judge) **MAY** gather evidence, summarize accounts, and prepare case files for human reviewers.\n- AI agents **CANNOT** issue rulings, determine fault, or recommend resolutions on safety incidents.\n- AI agents **MUST** flag any dispute that contains safety-related keywords or indicators for immediate human escalation, regardless of the dispute type selected by the filer.",
            "line_start": 163,
            "line_end": 167
          },
          "5.3": {
            "title": "Interim Measures",
            "text": "Upon escalation, the system may apply interim measures pending human review:\n\n- Temporary suspension of the accused party's account.\n- Prevention of new trip acceptance (for drivers) or booking (for riders).\n- These measures are lifted if the human reviewer determines no safety violation occurred.",
            "line_start": 169,
            "line_end": 175
          },
          "6.1": {
            "title": "Monetary Thresholds",
            "text": "| Dispute Value | Ruling Path | Agent Confidence Requirement |\n|---|---|---|\n| Under $10 | AI agent ruling is **final** | Any confidence level |\n| $10 – $50 | AI agent ruling with **80%+ confidence** | If confidence < 80%, escalate to human review |\n| Above $50 | **Always human review** | N/A — AI agent prepares case file only |",
            "line_start": 181,
            "line_end": 187
          },
          "6.2": {
            "title": "Category Thresholds",
            "text": "| Dispute Category | Ruling Path |\n|---|---|\n| Safety incident | **Always human review** (see Section 5) |\n| Fare dispute < $10 | AI agent ruling is final |\n| Fare dispute $10 – $50 | AI agent ruling if confidence ≥ 80%, else escalate |\n| Fare dispute > $50 | Always human review |\n| Route deviation | AI agent ruling if confidence ≥ 80% and deviation ≤ 2km, else escalate |\n| Property damage (cleaning ≤ $50) | AI agent ruling if photo evidence is verifiable |\n| Property damage (repair > $50) | Always human review |\n| No-show / cancellation | AI agent ruling is final (fee is fixed at $5.00) |",
            "line_start": 189,
            "line_end": 200
          },
          "6.3": {
            "title": "Confidence Calibration",
            "text": "- Agent confidence is calculated based on: evidence completeness, policy clarity, precedent alignment, and party credibility scores.\n- If any party has a fraud flag ≥ 1, the confidence threshold is raised to 95% regardless of dispute value.",
            "line_start": 202,
            "line_end": 205
          },
          "7.1": {
            "title": "Route Deviation Without Notification",
            "text": "| Field | Value |\n|---|---|\n| **Case ID** | DISP-2026-0089 |\n| **Date** | 2026-02-12 |\n| **Dispute Type** | route_deviation |\n| **Facts** | Driver rerouted from Geylang to Orchard via Nicoll Highway due to traffic. Deviation was 1.8km beyond recommended route. Rider was not informed. GPS telemetry confirmed traffic congestion on original route. |\n| **Ruling** | Partial refund of excess distance fare. Rationale: Driver had valid traffic justification (confirmed via traffic API), but failed to notify rider per Section 1.2. Refund applies only to the excess distance fare, not the entire trip. |\n| **Refund Amount** | $3.20 |\n| **Confidence** | 91% |",
            "line_start": 213,
            "line_end": 223
          },
          "7.2": {
            "title": "Surge Pricing Without Rider Notification",
            "text": "| Field | Value |\n|---|---|\n| **Case ID** | DISP-2026-0142 |\n| **Date** | 2026-04-03 |\n| **Dispute Type** | fare_dispute |\n| **Facts** | Rider received upfront quote of $9.50 at 1.0x surge. Surge increased to 1.4x between quote and pickup. Rider was not notified. Actual fare was $12.70 — a difference of $3.20 entirely attributable to surge differential. |\n| **Ruling** | Full refund of surge differential. Rationale: Per Section 3.3, if surge increases between quote and trip start and rider is not notified, rider is eligible for full refund of the surge differential. The $3.20 difference was solely attributable to surge multiplier change. |\n| **Refund Amount** | $3.20 |\n| **Confidence** | 96% |",
            "line_start": 225,
            "line_end": 235
          },
          "7.3": {
            "title": "No-Show Cancellation Without Contact Attempt",
            "text": "| Field | Value |\n|---|---|\n| **Case ID** | DISP-2026-0211 |\n| **Date** | 2026-05-18 |\n| **Dispute Type** | cancellation_fee |\n| **Facts** | Driver arrived at pickup, waited 6 minutes, and cancelled as no-show. $5.00 fee charged to rider. Review of chat logs and call records showed the driver sent zero messages and made zero calls before cancelling. Rider arrived at the pickup point 1 minute after cancellation. |\n| **Ruling** | Cancellation fee voided. Rationale: Per Section 2.3, the driver must attempt at least 1 in-app message and 1 call before cancelling for no-show. The driver failed to meet both contact obligations. The $5.00 fee is reversed and refunded to the rider. |\n| **Refund Amount** | $5.00 |\n| **Confidence** | 98% |",
            "line_start": 237,
            "line_end": 247
          }
        }
      }
    },

          双方陈述与回应

          offline_placeholder 只摘录已有陈述，不代表已完成真实 Agent 辩论。

          乘客 Advocate

          第一轮陈述

          • The rider stated that the upfront quote shown at booking was $12.00, but they were charged $16.50 without any notice of a fare adjustment or surge pricing. E-002 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.1
          • Trip records corroborate that the upfront quote was $12.00, the charged actual fare was $16.50, and the surge multiplier increased from 1.0x to 1.5x between quote and trip start. E-015 E-021 E-022 E-023 E-024 E-025 E-026 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.1 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.4 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.5
          • The surge pricing log explicitly records rider_notified=false with null notification timestamp and method when surge activated at 2026-09-14T21:04:30+08:00 prior to trip start. E-017 E-024 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.2
          • Under Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 Section 3.3 and Section 3.4, when a surge multiplier increases without required rider notification, the rider is eligible for a full refund of the surge differential ($4.50). E-015 E-023 E-024 E-025 E-026 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.2 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.3 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.4
          • The trip was completed over 13 minutes and the driver successfully picked up the rider following chat coordination, which confirms that the base service was rendered and the requested remedy is bounded to a partial refund of the $4.50 surge differential rather than the full trip fare. E-010 E-011 E-017 E-018 E-019 E-020 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.3 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.4

            回应对方

            • The rider reported receiving an upfront quote of $12.00 at booking and stated they were charged $16.50 without prior notice of any surge or price adjustment before or during the ride. E-002 E-012 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.1
            • Platform records confirm that the upfront quote was $12.00 at a 1.0x multiplier, but the actual fare charged was $16.50 following a mid-dispatch surge increase to 1.5x at 21:04:30. E-015 E-021 E-022 E-024 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.1
            • The surge pricing log explicitly records rider_notified=false with null notification method and timestamp, establishing an unnotified surge increase under Section 3.2. E-017 E-024 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.2
            • The entire $4.50 discrepancy is arithmetically attributable solely to the surge multiplier increase with fixed surge-exempt components, entitling the rider to a full refund of the $4.50 surge differential pursuant to Section 3.3 and Section 3.4. E-015 E-023 E-025 E-026 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.3 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.4 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.5
            • While the driver correctly notes that the transportation service was completed from pickup to drop-off, completed transit does not override the binding quote or policy requirement to notify the rider of surge increases prior to pickup. E-016 E-017 E-018 E-020 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.1 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.2
            • The driver side acknowledges that under Section 3.3 the remedy for an unnotified surge increase is a refund of the $4.50 surge differential, which directly supports granting the rider's requested remedy. E-002 E-024 E-025 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.3 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.4
            • Platform payout reconciliation terms indicating whether driver compensation adjustments occur upon platform-level surge differential refunds under Section 3.3.

            司机 Advocate

            第一轮陈述

            • The driver completed the trip as requested from Bugis Junction to Marina Bay Sands within the estimated 13-minute duration. E-010 E-011 E-016 E-017 E-018 E-019 E-020 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.1
            • The platform activated a 1.5x surge multiplier at 21:04:30 prior to trip start at 21:05:00 due to real-time market conditions. E-017 E-024 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.2
            • The driver is entitled to full compensation for the completed transportation service, as the driver fulfilled all driving duties and was not responsible for automated in-app pricing notifications. E-014 E-015 E-021 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.1
            • Under policy section 3.3, any remedy for lack of surge notification is limited strictly to a partial refund of the $4.50 surge differential, preserving the baseline quoted fare of $12.00 for the completed ride. E-015 E-022 E-023 E-024 E-025 E-026 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.3 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.4 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.5
            • The system log records rider_notified=false for the surge increase, which establishes under policy section 3.3 that the rider is eligible for a refund of the $4.50 surge differential. E-002 E-024 E-025 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.2 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.3 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.4
            • If platform policy mandates refunding the unnotified surge differential of $4.50 to the rider, this adjustment must not claw back the driver's base earnings for the completed trip. E-015 E-021 E-022 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.1 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.3
            • Platform payout reconciliation records clarifying whether an unnotified surge refund under section 3.3 is absorbed by the platform or deducted from driver remuneration.

            回应对方

            • The driver fulfilled all transportation obligations, successfully picking up the rider at Bugis Junction and completing the trip to Marina Bay Sands within the estimated 13-minute duration. E-001 E-010 E-011 E-016 E-017 E-018 E-019 E-020 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.1
            • The dynamic surge increase from 1.0x to 1.5x was triggered automatically by platform dispatch at 21:04:30 prior to trip start at 21:05:00, independent of any driver action or manual pricing modification. E-017 E-024 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.2
            • Under Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 Section 3.1, Section 3.3, and Section 3.4, the driver is entitled to retain baseline compensation for the rendered service, meaning any platform adjustment for unnotified surge is strictly confined to the $4.50 surge differential and cannot touch the core $12.00 trip fare. E-015 E-021 E-022 E-023 E-024 E-025 E-026 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.1 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.3 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.4 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.5
            • While the opponent correctly notes that surge_pricing_log records rider_notified=false, justifying a partial refund of the $4.50 surge differential under Section 3.3, this failure of platform in-app notification does not constitute driver fault or justify withholding the driver's earned baseline earnings. E-002 E-015 E-023 E-024 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.2 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.3 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.4

              政策与原文

              P-RYDE-2.1-S3.1 Section 3.1: Upfront Quote Binding

              来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §3.1 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

              [
  {
    "path": "/sections/3.1",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Upfront Quote Binding",
      "text": "- The upfront quote presented to the rider at booking is **binding at the surge multiplier in effect at quote time** (typically 1.0x in normal conditions).\n- The quoted fare includes: base fare, distance fare, time fare, booking fee, and any applicable surge.",
      "line_start": 76,
      "line_end": 79
    }
  }
]
              P-RYDE-2.1-S3.2 Section 3.2: Surge Change Notification

              来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §3.2 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

              [
  {
    "path": "/sections/3.2",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Surge Change Notification",
      "text": "- If the surge multiplier **increases** between the time of quote and the time of trip start, the rider **MUST be notified** via an **in-app notification** before or at the point of pickup.\n- The notification must clearly state:\n  - The new surge multiplier.\n  - The revised estimated fare.\n  - An option to cancel without penalty.",
      "line_start": 81,
      "line_end": 87
    }
  }
]
              P-RYDE-2.1-S3.3 Section 3.3: Refund Eligibility

              来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §3.3 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

              [
  {
    "path": "/sections/3.3",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Refund Eligibility",
      "text": "| Scenario | Rider Notified? | Refund |\n|---|---|---|\n| Surge increases, rider notified, rider proceeds | Yes | No refund — higher fare applies |\n| Surge increases, rider **not** notified | No | **Full refund of the surge differential** (actual fare − quoted fare) |\n| Surge decreases between quote and trip start | N/A | Lower fare applies automatically (rider benefits) |\n| Surge unchanged | N/A | Quoted fare applies |",
      "line_start": 89,
      "line_end": 96
    }
  }
]
              P-RYDE-2.1-S3.4 Section 3.4: Surge Differential Calculation

              来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §3.4 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

              [
  {
    "path": "/sections/3.4",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Surge Differential Calculation",
      "text": "```\nsurge_differential = actual_fare − upfront_quote\n```\n\nWhere the difference is attributable solely to a surge multiplier change (all other fare components unchanged), the full differential is refundable if the rider was not notified.",
      "line_start": 98,
      "line_end": 104
    }
  }
]
              P-RYDE-2.1-S3.5 Section 3.5: Surge-Exempt Components

              来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §3.5 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

              [
  {
    "path": "/sections/3.5",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Surge-Exempt Components",
      "text": "The following fare components are **exempt** from surge pricing and remain fixed regardless of multiplier:\n\n- Booking fee\n\nAll other components (base fare, distance fare, time fare) are subject to the surge multiplier.",
      "line_start": 106,
      "line_end": 112
    }
  }
]
              P-RYDE-2.1-S5.1 Section 5.1: Automatic Escalation

              来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §5.1 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

              [
  {
    "path": "/sections/5.1",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Automatic Escalation",
      "text": "Any dispute flagged as **safety-related** is **automatically escalated to human review**. Safety-related disputes include but are not limited to:\n\n- Reckless or dangerous driving.\n- Physical or verbal harassment.\n- Assault or threat of assault.\n- Inappropriate behavior or conduct.\n- Traffic accidents during the trip.\n- Rider or driver feeling unsafe during the trip.",
      "line_start": 152,
      "line_end": 161
    }
  }
]
              P-RYDE-2.1-S5.2 Section 5.2: AI Agent Limitations

              来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §5.2 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

              [
  {
    "path": "/sections/5.2",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "AI Agent Limitations",
      "text": "- AI agents (Rider Advocate, Driver Advocate, Judge) **MAY** gather evidence, summarize accounts, and prepare case files for human reviewers.\n- AI agents **CANNOT** issue rulings, determine fault, or recommend resolutions on safety incidents.\n- AI agents **MUST** flag any dispute that contains safety-related keywords or indicators for immediate human escalation, regardless of the dispute type selected by the filer.",
      "line_start": 163,
      "line_end": 167
    }
  }
]
              P-RYDE-2.1-S5.3 Section 5.3: Interim Measures

              来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §5.3 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

              [
  {
    "path": "/sections/5.3",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Interim Measures",
      "text": "Upon escalation, the system may apply interim measures pending human review:\n\n- Temporary suspension of the accused party's account.\n- Prevention of new trip acceptance (for drivers) or booking (for riders).\n- These measures are lifted if the human reviewer determines no safety violation occurred.",
      "line_start": 169,
      "line_end": 175
    }
  }
]
              P-RYDE-2.1-S6.1 Section 6.1: Monetary Thresholds

              来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §6.1 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

              [
  {
    "path": "/sections/6.1",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Monetary Thresholds",
      "text": "| Dispute Value | Ruling Path | Agent Confidence Requirement |\n|---|---|---|\n| Under $10 | AI agent ruling is **final** | Any confidence level |\n| $10 – $50 | AI agent ruling with **80%+ confidence** | If confidence < 80%, escalate to human review |\n| Above $50 | **Always human review** | N/A — AI agent prepares case file only |",
      "line_start": 181,
      "line_end": 187
    }
  }
]
              P-RYDE-2.1-S6.2 Section 6.2: Category Thresholds

              来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §6.2 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

              [
  {
    "path": "/sections/6.2",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Category Thresholds",
      "text": "| Dispute Category | Ruling Path |\n|---|---|\n| Safety incident | **Always human review** (see Section 5) |\n| Fare dispute < $10 | AI agent ruling is final |\n| Fare dispute $10 – $50 | AI agent ruling if confidence ≥ 80%, else escalate |\n| Fare dispute > $50 | Always human review |\n| Route deviation | AI agent ruling if confidence ≥ 80% and deviation ≤ 2km, else escalate |\n| Property damage (cleaning ≤ $50) | AI agent ruling if photo evidence is verifiable |\n| Property damage (repair > $50) | Always human review |\n| No-show / cancellation | AI agent ruling is final (fee is fixed at $5.00) |",
      "line_start": 189,
      "line_end": 200
    }
  }
]
              P-RYDE-2.1-S6.3 Section 6.3: Confidence Calibration

              来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §6.3 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

              [
  {
    "path": "/sections/6.3",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Confidence Calibration",
      "text": "- Agent confidence is calculated based on: evidence completeness, policy clarity, precedent alignment, and party credibility scores.\n- If any party has a fraud flag ≥ 1, the confidence threshold is raised to 95% regardless of dispute value.",
      "line_start": 202,
      "line_end": 205
    }
  }
]

      "policy": [
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S3.1",
          "rule": "Section 3.1: Upfront Quote Binding\n- The upfront quote presented to the rider at booking is **binding at the surge multiplier in effect at quote time** (typically 1.0x in normal conditions).\n- The quoted fare includes: base fare, distance fare, time fare, booking fee, and any applicable surge.",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §3.1"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S3.2",
          "rule": "Section 3.2: Surge Change Notification\n- If the surge multiplier **increases** between the time of quote and the time of trip start, the rider **MUST be notified** via an **in-app notification** before or at the point of pickup.\n- The notification must clearly state:\n  - The new surge multiplier.\n  - The revised estimated fare.\n  - An option to cancel without penalty.",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §3.2"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S3.3",
          "rule": "Section 3.3: Refund Eligibility\n| Scenario | Rider Notified? | Refund |\n|---|---|---|\n| Surge increases, rider notified, rider proceeds | Yes | No refund — higher fare applies |\n| Surge increases, rider **not** notified | No | **Full refund of the surge differential** (actual fare − quoted fare) |\n| Surge decreases between quote and trip start | N/A | Lower fare applies automatically (rider benefits) |\n| Surge unchanged | N/A | Quoted fare applies |",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §3.3"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S3.4",
          "rule": "Section 3.4: Surge Differential Calculation\n```\nsurge_differential = actual_fare − upfront_quote\n```\n\nWhere the difference is attributable solely to a surge multiplier change (all other fare components unchanged), the full differential is refundable if the rider was not notified.",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §3.4"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S3.5",
          "rule": "Section 3.5: Surge-Exempt Components\nThe following fare components are **exempt** from surge pricing and remain fixed regardless of multiplier:\n\n- Booking fee\n\nAll other components (base fare, distance fare, time fare) are subject to the surge multiplier.",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §3.5"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S5.1",
          "rule": "Section 5.1: Automatic Escalation\nAny dispute flagged as **safety-related** is **automatically escalated to human review**. Safety-related disputes include but are not limited to:\n\n- Reckless or dangerous driving.\n- Physical or verbal harassment.\n- Assault or threat of assault.\n- Inappropriate behavior or conduct.\n- Traffic accidents during the trip.\n- Rider or driver feeling unsafe during the trip.",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §5.1"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S5.2",
          "rule": "Section 5.2: AI Agent Limitations\n- AI agents (Rider Advocate, Driver Advocate, Judge) **MAY** gather evidence, summarize accounts, and prepare case files for human reviewers.\n- AI agents **CANNOT** issue rulings, determine fault, or recommend resolutions on safety incidents.\n- AI agents **MUST** flag any dispute that contains safety-related keywords or indicators for immediate human escalation, regardless of the dispute type selected by the filer.",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §5.2"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S5.3",
          "rule": "Section 5.3: Interim Measures\nUpon escalation, the system may apply interim measures pending human review:\n\n- Temporary suspension of the accused party's account.\n- Prevention of new trip acceptance (for drivers) or booking (for riders).\n- These measures are lifted if the human reviewer determines no safety violation occurred.",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §5.3"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S6.1",
          "rule": "Section 6.1: Monetary Thresholds\n| Dispute Value | Ruling Path | Agent Confidence Requirement |\n|---|---|---|\n| Under $10 | AI agent ruling is **final** | Any confidence level |\n| $10 – $50 | AI agent ruling with **80%+ confidence** | If confidence < 80%, escalate to human review |\n| Above $50 | **Always human review** | N/A — AI agent prepares case file only |",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §6.1"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S6.2",
          "rule": "Section 6.2: Category Thresholds\n| Dispute Category | Ruling Path |\n|---|---|\n| Safety incident | **Always human review** (see Section 5) |\n| Fare dispute < $10 | AI agent ruling is final |\n| Fare dispute $10 – $50 | AI agent ruling if confidence ≥ 80%, else escalate |\n| Fare dispute > $50 | Always human review |\n| Route deviation | AI agent ruling if confidence ≥ 80% and deviation ≤ 2km, else escalate |\n| Property damage (cleaning ≤ $50) | AI agent ruling if photo evidence is verifiable |\n| Property damage (repair > $50) | Always human review |\n| No-show / cancellation | AI agent ruling is final (fee is fixed at $5.00) |",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §6.2"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S6.3",
          "rule": "Section 6.3: Confidence Calibration\n- Agent confidence is calculated based on: evidence completeness, policy clarity, precedent alignment, and party credibility scores.\n- If any party has a fraud flag ≥ 1, the confidence threshold is raised to 95% regardless of dispute value.",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §6.3"
        },

Surge increased to 1.4x between quote and pickup. Rider was not notified. Rationale: Per Section 3.3, if surge increases between quote and trip start and rider is not notified, rider is eligible for full refund of the surge differential. The $3.20 difference was solely attributable to surge multiplier change. |\n| **Refund Amount** | $3.20 |\n| **Confidence** | 96% |",

        }
      ]
