    "policy_documents": {
      "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1": {
        "document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
        "title": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1",
        "version": "2.1",
        "effective_date": "2026-01-01",
        "source": {
          "filename": "Document 2 — Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 (Markdown).md",
          "archive_path": "sources/official/2026-10-15/policy-v2.1.md",
          "file_sha256": "827c4d2cab2d4db9e176521000b079632bbe80c20f69c3ffd0addecc8cbc8699"
        },
        "sections": {
          "1.1": {
            "title": "General Principle",
            "text": "Drivers are permitted to reroute from the GPS-recommended path in response to real-time traffic conditions, road closures, or congestion. However, the rider must be informed of any deviation.",
            "line_start": 12,
            "line_end": 14
          },
          "1.2": {
            "title": "Notification Requirement",
            "text": "- The driver **MUST** inform the rider of a route deviation via **in-app chat** or **verbally** (with the trip call recording as evidence) **before or at the point of deviation**.\n- A brief reason (e.g., \"traffic jam ahead onNicoll Highway, taking alternate route\") is sufficient.",
            "line_start": 16,
            "line_end": 19
          },
          "1.3": {
            "title": "Refund Eligibility Matrix",
            "text": "| Scenario | Rider Informed? | Deviation > 1km? | Refund |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| Driver reroutes for traffic, rider informed and agrees | Yes | Yes | No refund |\n| Driver reroutes for traffic, rider **not** informed | No | Yes | Partial refund of excess distance fare |\n| Driver reroutes for traffic, rider not informed | No | No (≤ 1km) | No refund (within tolerance) |\n| Driver reroutes **without** traffic justification (no evidence of congestion) | N/A | Yes | **Full refund** of excess distance fare |\n| Driver reroutes without justification, deviation ≤ 1km | N/A | No | No refund (within tolerance) |",
            "line_start": 21,
            "line_end": 29
          },
          "1.4": {
            "title": "Evidence Requirements",
            "text": "- Traffic justification is verified via **historical traffic API data** for the route segment at the trip time.\n- Route deviation distance is calculated as: `actual_route_distance − recommended_route_distance`.\n- If the driver's in-app chat or call recording confirms rider acknowledgment, the deviation is considered agreed.",
            "line_start": 31,
            "line_end": 35
          },
          "2.1": {
            "title": "Free Wait Time",
            "text": "- The driver must wait at the pickup location for a **free wait time of 5 minutes** from the scheduled pickup time.\n- After 5 minutes, the driver may cancel the trip as a \"rider no-show.\"",
            "line_start": 41,
            "line_end": 44
          },
          "2.2": {
            "title": "Cancellation Fee",
            "text": "- A **no-show cancellation fee of $5.00** is charged to the rider when the driver cancels after the free wait period.\n- The cancellation fee is transferred to the driver as compensation for time and fuel.",
            "line_start": 46,
            "line_end": 49
          },
          "2.3": {
            "title": "Driver Contact Obligation",
            "text": "Before cancelling for no-show, the driver **MUST** attempt to contact the rider with:\n\n1. **At least 1 in-app chat message**, AND\n2. **At least 1 phone call** (via the in-app calling system).\n\nIf the driver fails to meet both contact obligations, the cancellation fee is **voided** and the rider is not charged.",
            "line_start": 51,
            "line_end": 58
          },
          "2.4": {
            "title": "Driver No-Show",
            "text": "- If the driver **fails to arrive at the pickup location** within a reasonable time (defined as scheduled pickup time + 5 minutes), the rider may cancel at no charge.\n- If the driver fails to arrive **and** fails to attempt contact, the rider is eligible for a **$5.00 goodwill credit**.",
            "line_start": 60,
            "line_end": 63
          },
          "2.5": {
            "title": "Repeat No-Show Flagging",
            "text": "- If a rider accumulates **3 or more no-show cancellations within a 30-day rolling window**, the rider's account is **flagged** for review.\n- Flagged accounts are subject to:\n  - Mandatory upfront payment for future bookings.\n  - Temporary suspension pending review by the Trust & Safety team.",
            "line_start": 65,
            "line_end": 70
          },
          "3.1": {
            "title": "Upfront Quote Binding",
            "text": "- The upfront quote presented to the rider at booking is **binding at the surge multiplier in effect at quote time** (typically 1.0x in normal conditions).\n- The quoted fare includes: base fare, distance fare, time fare, booking fee, and any applicable surge.",
            "line_start": 76,
            "line_end": 79
          },
          "3.2": {
            "title": "Surge Change Notification",
            "text": "- If the surge multiplier **increases** between the time of quote and the time of trip start, the rider **MUST be notified** via an **in-app notification** before or at the point of pickup.\n- The notification must clearly state:\n  - The new surge multiplier.\n  - The revised estimated fare.\n  - An option to cancel without penalty.",
            "line_start": 81,
            "line_end": 87
          },
          "3.3": {
            "title": "Refund Eligibility",
            "text": "| Scenario | Rider Notified? | Refund |\n|---|---|---|\n| Surge increases, rider notified, rider proceeds | Yes | No refund — higher fare applies |\n| Surge increases, rider **not** notified | No | **Full refund of the surge differential** (actual fare − quoted fare) |\n| Surge decreases between quote and trip start | N/A | Lower fare applies automatically (rider benefits) |\n| Surge unchanged | N/A | Quoted fare applies |",
            "line_start": 89,
            "line_end": 96
          },
          "3.4": {
            "title": "Surge Differential Calculation",
            "text": "```\nsurge_differential = actual_fare − upfront_quote\n```\n\nWhere the difference is attributable solely to a surge multiplier change (all other fare components unchanged), the full differential is refundable if the rider was not notified.",
            "line_start": 98,
            "line_end": 104
          },
          "3.5": {
            "title": "Surge-Exempt Components",
            "text": "The following fare components are **exempt** from surge pricing and remain fixed regardless of multiplier:\n\n- Booking fee\n\nAll other components (base fare, distance fare, time fare) are subject to the surge multiplier.",
            "line_start": 106,
            "line_end": 112
          },
          "4.1": {
            "title": "Driver Claim Rights",
            "text": "Drivers may file claims for cleaning or repair fees resulting from **rider-caused damage** to the vehicle, including but not limited to:\n\n- Spills, vomiting, or food/beverage stains.\n- Physical damage to interior (seats, doors, windows).\n- Damage to exterior caused by rider behavior during boarding/alighting.",
            "line_start": 118,
            "line_end": 124
          },
          "4.2": {
            "title": "Evidence Requirements",
            "text": "| Requirement | Details |\n|---|---|\n| Photo evidence | Must be submitted **within 24 hours** of trip completion |\n| Timestamps | Photos must be automatically timestamped by the in-app camera |\n| Verifiability | Photos must be verifiable — taken through the Ryde driver app's built-in camera, not external uploads |\n| Trip association | Damage must be linked to the specific trip via GPS telemetry and trip timestamp |",
            "line_start": 126,
            "line_end": 133
          },
          "4.3": {
            "title": "Fee Structure",
            "text": "| Damage Type | Maximum Fee | Conditions |\n|---|---|---|\n| Cleaning fee | Up to **$50.00** | Photo evidence of soiling/stain; no external quote required |\n| Repair fee | Cost of repair | Requires a **written quote from a certified workshop**; quote must be submitted within 7 days |",
            "line_start": 135,
            "line_end": 140
          },
          "4.4": {
            "title": "Dispute Handling",
            "text": "- If the rider disputes the damage claim, the dispute is routed to human review.\n- The driver's photo evidence and the rider's account are both reviewed.\n- If evidence is insufficient (no timestamp, external photo, or damage not linked to trip), the claim is **rejected**.",
            "line_start": 142,
            "line_end": 146
          },
          "5.1": {
            "title": "Automatic Escalation",
            "text": "Any dispute flagged as **safety-related** is **automatically escalated to human review**. Safety-related disputes include but are not limited to:\n\n- Reckless or dangerous driving.\n- Physical or verbal harassment.\n- Assault or threat of assault.\n- Inappropriate behavior or conduct.\n- Traffic accidents during the trip.\n- Rider or driver feeling unsafe during the trip.",
            "line_start": 152,
            "line_end": 161
          },
          "5.2": {
            "title": "AI Agent Limitations",
            "text": "- AI agents (Rider Advocate, Driver Advocate, Judge) **MAY** gather evidence, summarize accounts, and prepare case files for human reviewers.\n- AI agents **CANNOT** issue rulings, determine fault, or recommend resolutions on safety incidents.\n- AI agents **MUST** flag any dispute that contains safety-related keywords or indicators for immediate human escalation, regardless of the dispute type selected by the filer.",
            "line_start": 163,
            "line_end": 167
          },
          "5.3": {
            "title": "Interim Measures",
            "text": "Upon escalation, the system may apply interim measures pending human review:\n\n- Temporary suspension of the accused party's account.\n- Prevention of new trip acceptance (for drivers) or booking (for riders).\n- These measures are lifted if the human reviewer determines no safety violation occurred.",
            "line_start": 169,
            "line_end": 175
          },
          "6.1": {
            "title": "Monetary Thresholds",
            "text": "| Dispute Value | Ruling Path | Agent Confidence Requirement |\n|---|---|---|\n| Under $10 | AI agent ruling is **final** | Any confidence level |\n| $10 – $50 | AI agent ruling with **80%+ confidence** | If confidence < 80%, escalate to human review |\n| Above $50 | **Always human review** | N/A — AI agent prepares case file only |",
            "line_start": 181,
            "line_end": 187
          },
          "6.2": {
            "title": "Category Thresholds",
            "text": "| Dispute Category | Ruling Path |\n|---|---|\n| Safety incident | **Always human review** (see Section 5) |\n| Fare dispute < $10 | AI agent ruling is final |\n| Fare dispute $10 – $50 | AI agent ruling if confidence ≥ 80%, else escalate |\n| Fare dispute > $50 | Always human review |\n| Route deviation | AI agent ruling if confidence ≥ 80% and deviation ≤ 2km, else escalate |\n| Property damage (cleaning ≤ $50) | AI agent ruling if photo evidence is verifiable |\n| Property damage (repair > $50) | Always human review |\n| No-show / cancellation | AI agent ruling is final (fee is fixed at $5.00) |",
            "line_start": 189,
            "line_end": 200
          },
          "6.3": {
            "title": "Confidence Calibration",
            "text": "- Agent confidence is calculated based on: evidence completeness, policy clarity, precedent alignment, and party credibility scores.\n- If any party has a fraud flag ≥ 1, the confidence threshold is raised to 95% regardless of dispute value.",
            "line_start": 202,
            "line_end": 205
          },
          "7.1": {
            "title": "Route Deviation Without Notification",
            "text": "| Field | Value |\n|---|---|\n| **Case ID** | DISP-2026-0089 |\n| **Date** | 2026-02-12 |\n| **Dispute Type** | route_deviation |\n| **Facts** | Driver rerouted from Geylang to Orchard via Nicoll Highway due to traffic. Deviation was 1.8km beyond recommended route. Rider was not informed. GPS telemetry confirmed traffic congestion on original route. |\n| **Ruling** | Partial refund of excess distance fare. Rationale: Driver had valid traffic justification (confirmed via traffic API), but failed to notify rider per Section 1.2.                     双方陈述与回应

                    offline_placeholder 只摘录已有陈述，不代表已完成真实 Agent 辩论。

                    乘客 Advocate

                    第一轮陈述

                    • The rider stated that the upfront quote shown at booking was $12.00, but a final fare of $16.50 was charged without any notice of a fare increase or surge pricing before or during the trip. E-002 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.1
                    • The rider contemporaneously questioned the $16.50 charge immediately upon dropoff via in-app chat, corroborating the rider's lack of awareness of any fare revision. E-012
                    • Under Section 3.1, the upfront quote presented to the rider at booking is binding at the quote-time surge multiplier. E-015 E-022 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.1
                    • The entire $4.50 fare difference between the charged fare ($16.50) and the upfront quote ($12.00) is attributable solely to an increase in the surge multiplier from 1.0x to 1.5x. E-015 E-021 E-022 E-023 E-025 E-026 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.4 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.5
                    • Under Section 3.3, if the surge multiplier increases and the rider was not notified, the rider is entitled to a full refund of the surge differential of $4.50. E-002 E-025 E-026 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.3 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.4
                    • A system log records that an in-app surge notification was sent at 21:04:40+08:00 (prior to the 21:05:00+08:00 trip start) showing multiplier 1.5x, revised fare $16.50, and free cancellation, which contradicts the rider's statement of non-notification. E-017 E-024 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.2 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.3
                    • Although the system records rider_notified=true, a transmitted in-app alert sent merely 20 seconds before trip start does not independently prove receipt or comprehension by the rider while actively coordinating boarding. E-010 E-011 E-017 E-024 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.2
                    • Client-side delivery confirmation or display acknowledgement logs verifying whether the rider actually received or viewed the in-app surge notification before boarding at 21:05:00+08:00.

                    回应对方

                    • The rider stated that the upfront quote shown at booking was $12.00, but a final fare of $16.50 was charged without being informed of any fare change, surge pricing, or price adjustment before or during the trip. E-002 E-012 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.1
                    • Under Section 3.1, the upfront quote presented to the rider at booking is binding at the surge multiplier in effect at quote time (1.0x), which established an expected fare of $12.00. E-015 E-022 E-024 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.1
                    • The entire $4.50 fare difference between the charged fare ($16.50) and the upfront quote ($12.00) is solely attributable to the surge multiplier increase from 1.0x to 1.5x on the $9.00 surgeable subtotal, with the booking fee remaining surge-exempt. E-015 E-021 E-022 E-023 E-025 E-026 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.4 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.5
                    • Under Section 3.3, if the surge multiplier increases and the rider was not notified, the rider is entitled to a full refund of the surge differential of $4.50. E-002 E-025 E-026 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.3 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.4
                    • While the system log records rider_notified=true with a notification timestamp at 21:04:40 (20 seconds prior to the trip start at 21:05:00), a recorded system event establishes transmission but does not prove actual delivery, display, or reading on the rider's device. E-017 E-024 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.2
                    • The opponent relies on the system log to argue that notification was satisfied and no refund is due under Section 3.3, but the 20-second interval between the recorded surge notification (21:04:40) and trip start (21:05:00) provided virtually no practical window for the rider to view the revised fare and exercise the penalty-free cancellation option. E-011 E-017 E-024 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.2 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.3
                    • Device-level receipt, delivery confirmation, or in-app view logs verifying whether the surge notification sent at 21:04:40 was displayed to or acknowledged by the rider prior to pickup.

                    司机 Advocate

                    第一轮陈述

                    • The trip was completed on time with identical estimated and actual duration of 13 minutes, and the driver is entitled to full compensation for the completed service. E-017 E-018 E-019 E-020 E-021 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.1
                    • System logs show that a surge notification satisfying all requirements—displaying the 1.5x multiplier, revised estimated fare of $16.50, and free cancellation—was sent via in-app notification at 21:04:40, prior to the trip start at 21:05:00. E-017 E-024 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.2
                    • Because the surge increase was properly notified before pickup and the rider proceeded with the trip, Ryde Policy v2.1 Section 3.3 explicitly mandates that no refund is due and the higher fare applies. E-015 E-024 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.3
                    • The entire $4.50 difference between the $12.00 quote and the $16.50 actual fare is solely attributable to the 1.5x surge multiplier applied to the $9.00 surgeable subtotal, with the booking fee remaining surge-exempt. E-015 E-025 E-026 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.4 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.5
                    • The rider stated they were not informed of any surge pricing or fare adjustment before or during the trip, which contradicts the recorded system log. E-002 E-012 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.2
                    • While the system records dispatching the notification at 21:04:40, system event records prove transmission rather than active reading by the rider; nevertheless, the policy requirement is satisfied by timely delivery before pickup. E-017 E-024 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.2 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.3
                    • Device-level receipt or display confirmation logs demonstrating whether the rider opened or acknowledged the in-app notification sent at 21:04:40.

                    回应对方

                    • The trip was completed precisely as estimated in 13 minutes from Bugis Junction to Marina Bay Sands, fulfilling the driver's full transportation service obligations. E-016 E-017 E-018 E-019 E-020 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.1
                    • The surge pricing log records that an in-app notification was dispatched at 2026-09-14T21:04:40+08:00 prior to trip start at 21:05:00+08:00, specifying the 1.5x multiplier, revised fare of $16.50, free cancellation offer, and rider_notified=true. E-017 E-024 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.2
                    • Under Ryde Policy v2.1 Section 3.3, when surge increases, the rider is notified via in-app notification before or at pickup, and the rider proceeds with the trip, no refund is due and the higher fare applies. E-017 E-024 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.2 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.3
                    • The fare breakdown establishes that the $4.50 fare difference consists strictly of the surge multiplier adjustment on the surgeable subtotal ($9.00 * 0.5 = $4.50), leaving base components and the booking fee compliant with Section 3.5. E-015 E-025 E-026 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.4 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.5
                    • The rider's reported dispute statement that no notice was given is directly contradicted by the system pricing log recording in-app notification dispatch and rider_notified=true at 21:04:40+08:00. E-002 E-024 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.2 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.3
                    • While the opponent argues the notification occurred only 20 seconds before trip start, Section 3.2 explicitly allows notification 'before or at the point of pickup' without imposing an additional minimum reading window. E-017 E-024 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.2
                    • The rider's post-trip message at 21:18:30+08:00 establishes that the rider questioned the fare at dropoff, but a post-trip statement does not disprove that the system-recorded in-app notification was issued prior to boarding. E-012 E-024 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.2
                    • Client-side device telemetry or screen-view acknowledgment confirming the exact second the in-app surge alert was rendered on the rider's phone display.

                    政策与原文

                    P-RYDE-2.1-S3.1 Section 3.1: Upfront Quote Binding

                    来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §3.1 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

                    [
  {
    "path": "/sections/3.1",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Upfront Quote Binding",
      "text": "- The upfront quote presented to the rider at booking is **binding at the surge multiplier in effect at quote time** (typically 1.0x in normal conditions).\n- The quoted fare includes: base fare, distance fare, time fare, booking fee, and any applicable surge.",
      "line_start": 76,
      "line_end": 79
    }
  }
]
                    P-RYDE-2.1-S3.2 Section 3.2: Surge Change Notification

                    来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §3.2 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

                    [
  {
    "path": "/sections/3.2",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Surge Change Notification",
      "text": "- If the surge multiplier **increases** between the time of quote and the time of trip start, the rider **MUST be notified** via an **in-app notification** before or at the point of pickup.\n- The notification must clearly state:\n  - The new surge multiplier.\n  - The revised estimated fare.\n  - An option to cancel without penalty.",
      "line_start": 81,
      "line_end": 87
    }
  }
]
                    P-RYDE-2.1-S3.3 Section 3.3: Refund Eligibility

                    来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §3.3 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

                    [
  {
    "path": "/sections/3.3",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Refund Eligibility",
      "text": "| Scenario | Rider Notified? | Refund |\n|---|---|---|\n| Surge increases, rider notified, rider proceeds | Yes | No refund — higher fare applies |\n| Surge increases, rider **not** notified | No | **Full refund of the surge differential** (actual fare − quoted fare) |\n| Surge decreases between quote and trip start | N/A | Lower fare applies automatically (rider benefits) |\n| Surge unchanged | N/A | Quoted fare applies |",
      "line_start": 89,
      "line_end": 96
    }
  }
]
                    P-RYDE-2.1-S3.4 Section 3.4: Surge Differential Calculation

                    来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §3.4 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

                    [
  {
    "path": "/sections/3.4",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Surge Differential Calculation",
      "text": "```\nsurge_differential = actual_fare − upfront_quote\n```\n\nWhere the difference is attributable solely to a surge multiplier change (all other fare components unchanged), the full differential is refundable if the rider was not notified.",
      "line_start": 98,
      "line_end": 104
    }
  }
]
                    P-RYDE-2.1-S3.5 Section 3.5: Surge-Exempt Components

                    来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §3.5 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

                    [
  {
    "path": "/sections/3.5",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Surge-Exempt Components",
      "text": "The following fare components are **exempt** from surge pricing and remain fixed regardless of multiplier:\n\n- Booking fee\n\nAll other components (base fare, distance fare, time fare) are subject to the surge multiplier.",
      "line_start": 106,
      "line_end": 112
    }
  }
]
                    P-RYDE-2.1-S5.1 Section 5.1: Automatic Escalation

                    来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §5.1 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

                    [
  {
    "path": "/sections/5.1",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Automatic Escalation",
      "text": "Any dispute flagged as **safety-related** is **automatically escalated to human review**. Safety-related disputes include but are not limited to:\n\n- Reckless or dangerous driving.\n- Physical or verbal harassment.\n- Assault or threat of assault.\n- Inappropriate behavior or conduct.\n- Traffic accidents during the trip.\n- Rider or driver feeling unsafe during the trip.",
      "line_start": 152,
      "line_end": 161
    }
  }
]
                    P-RYDE-2.1-S5.2 Section 5.2: AI Agent Limitations

                    来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §5.2 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

                    [
  {
    "path": "/sections/5.2",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "AI Agent Limitations",
      "text": "- AI agents (Rider Advocate, Driver Advocate, Judge) **MAY** gather evidence, summarize accounts, and prepare case files for human reviewers.\n- AI agents **CANNOT** issue rulings, determine fault, or recommend resolutions on safety incidents.\n- AI agents **MUST** flag any dispute that contains safety-related keywords or indicators for immediate human escalation, regardless of the dispute type selected by the filer.",
      "line_start": 163,
      "line_end": 167
    }
  }
]
                    P-RYDE-2.1-S5.3 Section 5.3: Interim Measures

                    来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §5.3 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

                    [
  {
    "path": "/sections/5.3",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Interim Measures",
      "text": "Upon escalation, the system may apply interim measures pending human review:\n\n- Temporary suspension of the accused party's account.\n- Prevention of new trip acceptance (for drivers) or booking (for riders).\n- These measures are lifted if the human reviewer determines no safety violation occurred.",
      "line_start": 169,
      "line_end": 175
    }
  }
]
                    P-RYDE-2.1-S6.1 Section 6.1: Monetary Thresholds

                    来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §6.1 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

                    [
  {
    "path": "/sections/6.1",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Monetary Thresholds",
      "text": "| Dispute Value | Ruling Path | Agent Confidence Requirement |\n|---|---|---|\n| Under $10 | AI agent ruling is **final** | Any confidence level |\n| $10 – $50 | AI agent ruling with **80%+ confidence** | If confidence < 80%, escalate to human review |\n| Above $50 | **Always human review** | N/A — AI agent prepares case file only |",
      "line_start": 181,
      "line_end": 187
    }
  }
]
                    P-RYDE-2.1-S6.2 Section 6.2: Category Thresholds

                    来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §6.2 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

                    [
  {
    "path": "/sections/6.2",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Category Thresholds",
      "text": "| Dispute Category | Ruling Path |\n|---|---|\n| Safety incident | **Always human review** (see Section 5) |\n| Fare dispute < $10 | AI agent ruling is final |\n| Fare dispute $10 – $50 | AI agent ruling if confidence ≥ 80%, else escalate |\n| Fare dispute > $50 | Always human review |\n| Route deviation | AI agent ruling if confidence ≥ 80% and deviation ≤ 2km, else escalate |\n| Property damage (cleaning ≤ $50) | AI agent ruling if photo evidence is verifiable |\n| Property damage (repair > $50) | Always human review |\n| No-show / cancellation | AI agent ruling is final (fee is fixed at $5.00) |",
      "line_start": 189,
      "line_end": 200
    }
  }
]
                    P-RYDE-2.1-S6.3 Section 6.3: Confidence Calibration

                    来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §6.3 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

                    [
  {
    "path": "/sections/6.3",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Confidence Calibration",
      "text": "- Agent confidence is calculated based on: evidence completeness, policy clarity, precedent alignment, and party credibility scores.\n- If any party has a fraud flag ≥ 1, the confidence threshold is raised to 95% regardless of dispute value.",
      "line_start": 202,
      "line_end": 205
    }
  }
]

Surge increased to 1.4x between quote and pickup. Rider was not notified. The $3.20 difference was solely attributable to surge multiplier change. |\n| **Refund Amount** | $3.20 |\n| **Confidence** | 96% |",

      "policy": [
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S3.1",
          "rule": "Section 3.1: Upfront Quote Binding\n- The upfront quote presented to the rider at booking is **binding at the surge multiplier in effect at quote time** (typically 1.0x in normal conditions).\n- The quoted fare includes: base fare, distance fare, time fare, booking fee, and any applicable surge.",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §3.1"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S3.2",
          "rule": "Section 3.2: Surge Change Notification\n- If the surge multiplier **increases** between the time of quote and the time of trip start, the rider **MUST be notified** via an **in-app notification** before or at the point of pickup.\n- The notification must clearly state:\n  - The new surge multiplier.\n  - The revised estimated fare.\n  - An option to cancel without penalty.",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §3.2"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S3.3",
          "rule": "Section 3.3: Refund Eligibility\n| Scenario | Rider Notified? | Refund |\n|---|---|---|\n| Surge increases, rider notified, rider proceeds | Yes | No refund — higher fare applies |\n| Surge increases, rider **not** notified | No | **Full refund of the surge differential** (actual fare − quoted fare) |\n| Surge decreases between quote and trip start | N/A | Lower fare applies automatically (rider benefits) |\n| Surge unchanged | N/A | Quoted fare applies |",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §3.3"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S3.4",
          "rule": "Section 3.4: Surge Differential Calculation\n```\nsurge_differential = actual_fare − upfront_quote\n```\n\nWhere the difference is attributable solely to a surge multiplier change (all other fare components unchanged), the full differential is refundable if the rider was not notified.",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §3.4"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S3.5",
          "rule": "Section 3.5: Surge-Exempt Components\nThe following fare components are **exempt** from surge pricing and remain fixed regardless of multiplier:\n\n- Booking fee\n\nAll other components (base fare, distance fare, time fare) are subject to the surge multiplier.",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §3.5"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S5.1",
          "rule": "Section 5.1: Automatic Escalation\nAny dispute flagged as **safety-related** is **automatically escalated to human review**. Safety-related disputes include but are not limited to:\n\n- Reckless or dangerous driving.\n- Physical or verbal harassment.\n- Assault or threat of assault.\n- Inappropriate behavior or conduct.\n- Traffic accidents during the trip.\n- Rider or driver feeling unsafe during the trip.",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §5.1"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S5.2",
          "rule": "Section 5.2: AI Agent Limitations\n- AI agents (Rider Advocate, Driver Advocate, Judge) **MAY** gather evidence, summarize accounts, and prepare case files for human reviewers.\n- AI agents **CANNOT** issue rulings, determine fault, or recommend resolutions on safety incidents.\n- AI agents **MUST** flag any dispute that contains safety-related keywords or indicators for immediate human escalation, regardless of the dispute type selected by the filer.",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §5.2"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S5.3",
          "rule": "Section 5.3: Interim Measures\nUpon escalation, the system may apply interim measures pending human review:\n\n- Temporary suspension of the accused party's account.\n- Prevention of new trip acceptance (for drivers) or booking (for riders).\n- These measures are lifted if the human reviewer determines no safety violation occurred.",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §5.3"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S6.1",
          "rule": "Section 6.1: Monetary Thresholds\n| Dispute Value | Ruling Path | Agent Confidence Requirement |\n|---|---|---|\n| Under $10 | AI agent ruling is **final** | Any confidence level |\n| $10 – $50 | AI agent ruling with **80%+ confidence** | If confidence < 80%, escalate to human review |\n| Above $50 | **Always human review** | N/A — AI agent prepares case file only |",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §6.1"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S6.2",
          "rule": "Section 6.2: Category Thresholds\n| Dispute Category | Ruling Path |\n|---|---|\n| Safety incident | **Always human review** (see Section 5) |\n| Fare dispute < $10 | AI agent ruling is final |\n| Fare dispute $10 – $50 | AI agent ruling if confidence ≥ 80%, else escalate |\n| Fare dispute > $50 | Always human review |\n| Route deviation | AI agent ruling if confidence ≥ 80% and deviation ≤ 2km, else escalate |\n| Property damage (cleaning ≤ $50) | AI agent ruling if photo evidence is verifiable |\n| Property damage (repair > $50) | Always human review |\n| No-show / cancellation | AI agent ruling is final (fee is fixed at $5.00) |",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §6.2"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S6.3",
          "rule": "Section 6.3: Confidence Calibration\n- Agent confidence is calculated based on: evidence completeness, policy clarity, precedent alignment, and party credibility scores.\n- If any party has a fraud flag ≥ 1, the confidence threshold is raised to 95% regardless of dispute value.",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §6.3"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S7.2",
          "rule": "Section 7.2: Surge Pricing Without Rider Notification\n| Field | Value |\n|---|---|\n| **Case ID** | DISP-2026-0142 |\n| **Date** | 2026-04-03 |\n| **Dispute Type** | fare_dispute |\n| **Facts** | Rider received upfront quote of $9.50 at 1.0x surge. Surge increased to 1.4x between quote and pickup. Rider was not notified. Actual fare was $12.70 — a difference of $3.20 entirely attributable to surge differential. |\n| **Ruling** | Full refund of surge differential. Rationale: Per Section 3.3, if surge increases between quote and trip start and rider is not notified, rider is eligible for full refund of the surge differential. The $3.20 difference was solely attributable to surge multiplier change. |\n| **Refund Amount** | $3.20 |\n| **Confidence** | 96% |",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §7.2"
        }
      ]
    },

    "policy_documents": {
      "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1": {
        "document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
        "title": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1",
        "version": "2.1",
        "effective_date": "2026-01-01",
        "source": {
          "filename": "Document 2 — Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 (Markdown).md",
          "archive_path": "sources/official/2026-10-15/policy-v2.1.md",
          "file_sha256": "827c4d2cab2d4db9e176521000b079632bbe80c20f69c3ffd0addecc8cbc8699"
        },
        "sections": {
          "1.1": {
            "title": "General Principle",
            "text": "Drivers are permitted to reroute from the GPS-recommended path in response to real-time traffic conditions, road closures, or congestion. However, the rider must be informed of any deviation.",
            "line_start": 12,
            "line_end": 14
          },
          "1.2": {
            "title": "Notification Requirement",
            "text": "- The driver **MUST** inform the rider of a route deviation via **in-app chat** or **verbally** (with the trip call recording as evidence) **before or at the point of deviation**.\n- A brief reason (e.g., \"traffic jam ahead onNicoll Highway, taking alternate route\") is sufficient.",
            "line_start": 16,
            "line_end": 19
          },
          "1.3": {
            "title": "Refund Eligibility Matrix",
            "text": "| Scenario | Rider Informed? | Deviation > 1km? | Refund |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| Driver reroutes for traffic, rider informed and agrees | Yes | Yes | No refund |\n| Driver reroutes for traffic, rider **not** informed | No | Yes | Partial refund of excess distance fare |\n| Driver reroutes for traffic, rider not informed | No | No (≤ 1km) | No refund (within tolerance) |\n| Driver reroutes **without** traffic justification (no evidence of congestion) | N/A | Yes | **Full refund** of excess distance fare |\n| Driver reroutes without justification, deviation ≤ 1km | N/A | No | No refund (within tolerance) |",
            "line_start": 21,
            "line_end": 29
          },
          "1.4": {
            "title": "Evidence Requirements",
            "text": "- Traffic justification is verified via **historical traffic API data** for the route segment at the trip time.\n- Route deviation distance is calculated as: `actual_route_distance − recommended_route_distance`.\n- If the driver's in-app chat or call recording confirms rider acknowledgment, the deviation is considered agreed.",
            "line_start": 31,
            "line_end": 35
          },
          "2.1": {
            "title": "Free Wait Time",
            "text": "- The driver must wait at the pickup location for a **free wait time of 5 minutes** from the scheduled pickup time.\n- After 5 minutes, the driver may cancel the trip as a \"rider no-show.\"",
            "line_start": 41,
            "line_end": 44
          },
          "2.2": {
            "title": "Cancellation Fee",
            "text": "- A **no-show cancellation fee of $5.00** is charged to the rider when the driver cancels after the free wait period.\n- The cancellation fee is transferred to the driver as compensation for time and fuel.",
            "line_start": 46,
            "line_end": 49
          },
          "2.3": {
            "title": "Driver Contact Obligation",
            "text": "Before cancelling for no-show, the driver **MUST** attempt to contact the rider with:\n\n1. **At least 1 in-app chat message**, AND\n2. **At least 1 phone call** (via the in-app calling system).\n\nIf the driver fails to meet both contact obligations, the cancellation fee is **voided** and the rider is not charged.",
            "line_start": 51,
            "line_end": 58
          },
          "2.4": {
            "title": "Driver No-Show",
            "text": "- If the driver **fails to arrive at the pickup location** within a reasonable time (defined as scheduled pickup time + 5 minutes), the rider may cancel at no charge.\n- If the driver fails to arrive **and** fails to attempt contact, the rider is eligible for a **$5.00 goodwill credit**.",
            "line_start": 60,
            "line_end": 63
          },
          "2.5": {
            "title": "Repeat No-Show Flagging",
            "text": "- If a rider accumulates **3 or more no-show cancellations within a 30-day rolling window**, the rider's account is **flagged** for review.\n- Flagged accounts are subject to:\n  - Mandatory upfront payment for future bookings.\n  - Temporary suspension pending review by the Trust & Safety team.",
            "line_start": 65,
            "line_end": 70
          },
          "3.1": {
            "title": "Upfront Quote Binding",
            "text": "- The upfront quote presented to the rider at booking is **binding at the surge multiplier in effect at quote time** (typically 1.0x in normal conditions).\n- The quoted fare includes: base fare, distance fare, time fare, booking fee, and any applicable surge.",
            "line_start": 76,
            "line_end": 79
          },
          "3.2": {
            "title": "Surge Change Notification",
            "text": "- If the surge multiplier **increases** between the time of quote and the time of trip start, the rider **MUST be notified** via an **in-app notification** before or at the point of pickup.\n- The notification must clearly state:\n  - The new surge multiplier.\n  - The revised estimated fare.\n  - An option to cancel without penalty.",
            "line_start": 81,
            "line_end": 87
          },
          "3.3": {
            "title": "Refund Eligibility",
            "text": "| Scenario | Rider Notified? | Refund |\n|---|---|---|\n| Surge increases, rider notified, rider proceeds | Yes | No refund — higher fare applies |\n| Surge increases, rider **not** notified | No | **Full refund of the surge differential** (actual fare − quoted fare) |\n| Surge decreases between quote and trip start | N/A | Lower fare applies automatically (rider benefits) |\n| Surge unchanged | N/A | Quoted fare applies |",
            "line_start": 89,
            "line_end": 96
          },
          "3.4": {
            "title": "Surge Differential Calculation",
            "text": "```\nsurge_differential = actual_fare − upfront_quote\n```\n\nWhere the difference is attributable solely to a surge multiplier change (all other fare components unchanged), the full differential is refundable if the rider was not notified.",
            "line_start": 98,
            "line_end": 104
          },
          "3.5": {
            "title": "Surge-Exempt Components",
            "text": "The following fare components are **exempt** from surge pricing and remain fixed regardless of multiplier:\n\n- Booking fee\n\nAll other components (base fare, distance fare, time fare) are subject to the surge multiplier.",
            "line_start": 106,
            "line_end": 112
          },
          "4.1": {
            "title": "Driver Claim Rights",
            "text": "Drivers may file claims for cleaning or repair fees resulting from **rider-caused damage** to the vehicle, including but not limited to:\n\n- Spills, vomiting, or food/beverage stains.\n- Physical damage to interior (seats, doors, windows).\n- Damage to exterior caused by rider behavior during boarding/alighting.",
            "line_start": 118,
            "line_end": 124
          },
          "4.2": {
            "title": "Evidence Requirements",
            "text": "| Requirement | Details |\n|---|---|\n| Photo evidence | Must be submitted **within 24 hours** of trip completion |\n| Timestamps | Photos must be automatically timestamped by the in-app camera |\n| Verifiability | Photos must be verifiable — taken through the Ryde driver app's built-in camera, not external uploads |\n| Trip association | Damage must be linked to the specific trip via GPS telemetry and trip timestamp |",
            "line_start": 126,
            "line_end": 133
          },
          "4.3": {
            "title": "Fee Structure",
            "text": "| Damage Type | Maximum Fee | Conditions |\n|---|---|---|\n| Cleaning fee | Up to **$50.00** | Photo evidence of soiling/stain; no external quote required |\n| Repair fee | Cost of repair | Requires a **written quote from a certified workshop**; quote must be submitted within 7 days |",
            "line_start": 135,
            "line_end": 140
          },
          "4.4": {
            "title": "Dispute Handling",
            "text": "- If the rider disputes the damage claim, the dispute is routed to human review.\n- The driver's photo evidence and the rider's account are both reviewed.\n- If evidence is insufficient (no timestamp, external photo, or damage not linked to trip), the claim is **rejected**.",
            "line_start": 142,
            "line_end": 146
          },
          "5.1": {
            "title": "Automatic Escalation",
            "text": "Any dispute flagged as **safety-related** is **automatically escalated to human review**. Safety-related disputes include but are not limited to:\n\n- Reckless or dangerous driving.\n- Physical or verbal harassment.\n- Assault or threat of assault.\n- Inappropriate behavior or conduct.\n- Traffic accidents during the trip.\n- Rider or driver feeling unsafe during the trip.",
            "line_start": 152,
            "line_end": 161
          },
          "5.2": {
            "title": "AI Agent Limitations",
            "text": "- AI agents (Rider Advocate, Driver Advocate, Judge) **MAY** gather evidence, summarize accounts, and prepare case files for human reviewers.\n- AI agents **CANNOT** issue rulings, determine fault, or recommend resolutions on safety incidents.\n- AI agents **MUST** flag any dispute that contains safety-related keywords or indicators for immediate human escalation, regardless of the dispute type selected by the filer.",
            "line_start": 163,
            "line_end": 167
          },
          "5.3": {
            "title": "Interim Measures",
            "text": "Upon escalation, the system may apply interim measures pending human review:\n\n- Temporary suspension of the accused party's account.\n- Prevention of new trip acceptance (for drivers) or booking (for riders).\n- These measures are lifted if the human reviewer determines no safety violation occurred.",
            "line_start": 169,
            "line_end": 175
          },
          "6.1": {
            "title": "Monetary Thresholds",
            "text": "| Dispute Value | Ruling Path | Agent Confidence Requirement |\n|---|---|---|\n| Under $10 | AI agent ruling is **final** | Any confidence level |\n| $10 – $50 | AI agent ruling with **80%+ confidence** | If confidence < 80%, escalate to human review |\n| Above $50 | **Always human review** | N/A — AI agent prepares case file only |",
            "line_start": 181,
            "line_end": 187
          },
          "6.2": {
            "title": "Category Thresholds",
            "text": "| Dispute Category | Ruling Path |\n|---|---|\n| Safety incident | **Always human review** (see Section 5) |\n| Fare dispute < $10 | AI agent ruling is final |\n| Fare dispute $10 – $50 | AI agent ruling if confidence ≥ 80%, else escalate |\n| Fare dispute > $50 | Always human review |\n| Route deviation | AI agent ruling if confidence ≥ 80% and deviation ≤ 2km, else escalate |\n| Property damage (cleaning ≤ $50) | AI agent ruling if photo evidence is verifiable |\n| Property damage (repair > $50) | Always human review |\n| No-show / cancellation | AI agent ruling is final (fee is fixed at $5.00) |",
            "line_start": 189,
            "line_end": 200
          },
          "6.3": {
            "title": "Confidence Calibration",
            "text": "- Agent confidence is calculated based on: evidence completeness, policy clarity, precedent alignment, and party credibility scores.\n- If any party has a fraud flag ≥ 1, the confidence threshold is raised to 95% regardless of dispute value.",
            "line_start": 202,
            "line_end": 205
          },
          "7.1": {
            "title": "Route Deviation Without Notification",
            "text": "| Field | Value |\n|---|---|\n| **Case ID** | DISP-2026-0089 |\n| **Date** | 2026-02-12 |\n| **Dispute Type** | route_deviation |\n| **Facts** | Driver rerouted from Geylang to Orchard via Nicoll Highway due to traffic. Deviation was 1.8km beyond recommended route. Rider was not informed. GPS telemetry confirmed traffic congestion on original route. |\n| **Ruling** | Partial refund of excess distance fare. Rationale: Driver had valid traffic justification (confirmed via traffic API), but failed to notify rider per Section 1.2. Refund applies only to the excess distance fare, not the entire trip. |\n| **Refund Amount** | $3.20 |\n| **Confidence** | 91% |",
            "line_start": 213,
            "line_end": 223
          },
          "7.2": {
            "title": "Surge Pricing Without Rider Notification",
            "text": "| Field | Value |\n|---|---|\n| **Case ID** | DISP-2026-0142 |\n| **Date** | 2026-04-03 |\n| **Dispute Type** | fare_dispute |\n| **Facts** | Rider received upfront quote of $9.50 at 1.0x surge. Surge increased to 1.4x between quote and pickup. Rider was not notified. Actual fare was $12.70 — a difference of $3.20 entirely attributable to surge differential. |\n| **Ruling** | Full refund of surge differential. Rationale: Per Section 3.3, if surge increases between quote and trip start and rider is not notified, rider is eligible for full refund of the surge differential. The $3.20 difference was solely attributable to surge multiplier change. |\n| **Refund Amount** | $3.20 |\n| **Confidence** | 96% |",
            "line_start": 225,
            "line_end": 235
          },
          "7.3": {
            "title": "No-Show Cancellation Without Contact Attempt",
            "text": "| Field | Value |\n|---|---|\n| **Case ID** | DISP-2026-0211 |\n| **Date** | 2026-05-18 |\n| **Dispute Type** | cancellation_fee |\n| **Facts** | Driver arrived at pickup, waited 6 minutes, and cancelled as no-show. $5.00 fee charged to rider. Review of chat logs and call records showed the driver sent zero messages and made zero calls before cancelling. Rider arrived at the pickup point 1 minute after cancellation. |\n| **Ruling** | Cancellation fee voided. Rationale: Per Section 2.3, the driver must attempt at least 1 in-app message and 1 call before cancelling for no-show. The driver failed to meet both contact obligations. The $5.00 fee is reversed and refunded to the rider. |\n| **Refund Amount** | $5.00 |\n| **Confidence** | 98% |",
            "line_start": 237,
            "line_end": 247
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

                    Judge 如何看双方观点

                    以下为通过结构和引用检查的分析；这些检查不能证明自然语言推理正确。

                    核心问题

                    Is the rider entitled to a $4.50 refund of the surge differential under Section 3.3 due to an unnotified surge increase from 1.0x to 1.5x, or was the required in-app notification delivered prior to trip start, validating the $16.50 fare?

                    乘客观点 · 部分有依据支持

                    The upfront quote, fare breakdown arithmetic, and contemporaneous objection are verified, but non-receipt of the required surge notification relies on party assertion and missing technical dispatch records.

                    司机观点 · 部分有依据支持

                    Trip completion, timing, and surge activation prior to pickup are verified, but whether the rider was properly notified and bound by the higher fare remains unverified due to missing system logs.

                    争议点分析

                    • Whether the required in-app surge notification under Section 3.2 was transmitted to and displayed for the rider prior to pickup.

                      Under Section 3.2 and Section 3.3, a surge increase between quote and trip start requires an in-app notification before or at pickup. While surge activation at 21:04:30 is recorded, the audit confirms notification status is missing. Under the local review plan, SURGE_NOTIFICATION_STATUS_MISSING is a clarification issue that cannot be resolved autonomously.

                      E-002 E-012 E-017 E-024 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.2 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.3
                    • Scope of refund remedy if lack of notice is established.

                      Both parties and policy Section 3.3 and Section 3.4 agree that any refund is strictly limited to the $4.50 surge differential, preserving the driver's base fare earnings.

                      E-015 E-021 E-022 E-025 E-026 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.3 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.4 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.5

                    • SURGE_NOTIFICATION_STATUS_MISSING · 仍待澄清

                      The audit classifies SURGE_NOTIFICATION_STATUS_MISSING as requires_clarification. Missing logs cannot be equated to proof of negative transmission or confirmed delivery without technical push logs.

                      E-024 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.2 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.3

                    仍需补充的信息

                    • In-app push notification delivery logs and client-side display receipts between 21:04:30 and 21:05:00 verifying whether rider R-9001 received the 1.5x surge notification and penalty-free cancellation prompt before trip start.

                      差异：In precedent DISP-2026-0142, the record affirmatively established that the rider was not notified, whereas in DISP-003 notification delivery status is missing from logs.

E-015 E-021 E-023 E-025 E-026 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.4 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.5
                      • The rider stated that they were never notified of any surge pricing, fare change, or price adjustment before or during the trip, immediately questioning the $16.50 charge upon dropoff. E-002 E-012 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.2
                      • Under policy Section 3.3, when surge increases between quote and trip start and the rider is not notified via required in-app notification before or at pickup, the rider is entitled to a full refund of the surge differential of $4.50. E-002 E-015 E-024 E-025 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.2 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.3 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.4
                      • While surge window activation was logged at 21:04:30 prior to trip start at 21:05:00, the system records contain no affirmative log of an in-app notice, revised fare estimate, or penalty-free cancellation prompt being transmitted to the rider. E-017 E-024 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.2
                      • Although an absent dispatch notification log does not mathematically disprove transmission outside the system records, the lack of recorded delivery corroborates the rider's immediate contemporaneous objection upon arrival. E-002 E-012 E-024 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.3
                      • In-app push notification delivery logs and client-side display receipts between 21:04:30 and 21:05:00 showing whether the revised 1.5x surge notice and penalty-free cancellation option were actually presented to rider R-9001.

                      回应对方

                      • The rider was presented with an upfront quote of $12.00 at a 1.0x surge multiplier, which is binding under Section 3.1. E-015 E-022 E-024 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.1
                      • The rider stated that they were never notified of any fare change, surge pricing, or price adjustment before or during the trip, and promptly questioned the $16.50 charge upon dropoff. E-002 E-012 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.2
                      • The difference between the charged fare of $16.50 and the quoted fare of $12.00 is exactly $4.50, which is solely attributable to the surge multiplier increase from 1.0x to 1.5x with a fixed surgeable subtotal of $9.00 and surge-exempt booking fee. E-015 E-021 E-022 E-023 E-025 E-026 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.4 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.5
                      • Under Section 3.3, if a surge increase occurs between quote and pickup and the rider is not notified via the required in-app notification, the rider is entitled to a full refund of the surge differential of $4.50. E-015 E-024 E-025 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.2 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.3 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.4
                      • The driver's argument that the trip was fully completed within 13 minutes is supported by trip records, but completing the ride does not exempt the fare calculation from Section 3.2 notice requirements. E-016 E-017 E-018 E-019 E-020 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.1 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.2
                      • The driver correctly notes that the remedy under Section 3.3 and Section 3.4 is strictly limited to the surge differential of $4.50 rather than a refund of the full $16.50 trip fare; the rider's request is properly scoped to this $4.50 differential. E-002 E-015 E-025 E-026 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.3 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.4

                      政策与原文

                      P-RYDE-2.1-S3.1 Section 3.1: Upfront Quote Binding

                      来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §3.1 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

                      [
  {
    "path": "/sections/3.1",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Upfront Quote Binding",
      "text": "- The upfront quote presented to the rider at booking is **binding at the surge multiplier in effect at quote time** (typically 1.0x in normal conditions).\n- The quoted fare includes: base fare, distance fare, time fare, booking fee, and any applicable surge.",
      "line_start": 76,
      "line_end": 79
    }
  }
]
                      P-RYDE-2.1-S3.2 Section 3.2: Surge Change Notification

                      来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §3.2 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

                      [
  {
    "path": "/sections/3.2",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Surge Change Notification",
      "text": "- If the surge multiplier **increases** between the time of quote and the time of trip start, the rider **MUST be notified** via an **in-app notification** before or at the point of pickup.\n- The notification must clearly state:\n  - The new surge multiplier.\n  - The revised estimated fare.\n  - An option to cancel without penalty.",
      "line_start": 81,
      "line_end": 87
    }
  }
]
                      P-RYDE-2.1-S3.3 Section 3.3: Refund Eligibility

                      来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §3.3 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

                      [
  {
    "path": "/sections/3.3",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Refund Eligibility",
      "text": "| Scenario | Rider Notified? | Refund |\n|---|---|---|\n| Surge increases, rider notified, rider proceeds | Yes | No refund — higher fare applies |\n| Surge increases, rider **not** notified | No | **Full refund of the surge differential** (actual fare − quoted fare) |\n| Surge decreases between quote and trip start | N/A | Lower fare applies automatically (rider benefits) |\n| Surge unchanged | N/A | Quoted fare applies |",
      "line_start": 89,
      "line_end": 96
    }
  }
]
                      P-RYDE-2.1-S3.4 Section 3.4: Surge Differential Calculation

                      来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §3.4 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

                      [
  {
    "path": "/sections/3.4",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Surge Differential Calculation",
      "text": "```\nsurge_differential = actual_fare − upfront_quote\n```\n\nWhere the difference is attributable solely to a surge multiplier change (all other fare components unchanged), the full differential is refundable if the rider was not notified.",
      "line_start": 98,
      "line_end": 104
    }
  }
]
                      P-RYDE-2.1-S3.5 Section 3.5: Surge-Exempt Components

                      来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §3.5 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

                      [
  {
    "path": "/sections/3.5",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Surge-Exempt Components",
      "text": "The following fare components are **exempt** from surge pricing and remain fixed regardless of multiplier:\n\n- Booking fee\n\nAll other components (base fare, distance fare, time fare) are subject to the surge multiplier.",
      "line_start": 106,
      "line_end": 112
    }
  }
]
                      P-RYDE-2.1-S5.1 Section 5.1: Automatic Escalation

                      来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §5.1 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

                      [
  {
    "path": "/sections/5.1",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Automatic Escalation",
      "text": "Any dispute flagged as **safety-related** is **automatically escalated to human review**. Safety-related disputes include but are not limited to:\n\n- Reckless or dangerous driving.\n- Physical or verbal harassment.\n- Assault or threat of assault.\n- Inappropriate behavior or conduct.\n- Traffic accidents during the trip.\n- Rider or driver feeling unsafe during the trip.",
      "line_start": 152,
      "line_end": 161
    }
  }
]
                      P-RYDE-2.1-S5.2 Section 5.2: AI Agent Limitations

                      来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §5.2 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

                      [
  {
    "path": "/sections/5.2",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "AI Agent Limitations",
      "text": "- AI agents (Rider Advocate, Driver Advocate, Judge) **MAY** gather evidence, summarize accounts, and prepare case files for human reviewers.\n- AI agents **CANNOT** issue rulings, determine fault, or recommend resolutions on safety incidents.\n- AI agents **MUST** flag any dispute that contains safety-related keywords or indicators for immediate human escalation, regardless of the dispute type selected by the filer.",
      "line_start": 163,
      "line_end": 167
    }
  }
]
                      P-RYDE-2.1-S5.3 Section 5.3: Interim Measures

                      来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §5.3 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

                      [
  {
    "path": "/sections/5.3",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Interim Measures",
      "text": "Upon escalation, the system may apply interim measures pending human review:\n\n- Temporary suspension of the accused party's account.\n- Prevention of new trip acceptance (for drivers) or booking (for riders).\n- These measures are lifted if the human reviewer determines no safety violation occurred.",
      "line_start": 169,
      "line_end": 175
    }
  }
]
                      P-RYDE-2.1-S6.1 Section 6.1: Monetary Thresholds

                      来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §6.1 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

                      [
  {
    "path": "/sections/6.1",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Monetary Thresholds",
      "text": "| Dispute Value | Ruling Path | Agent Confidence Requirement |\n|---|---|---|\n| Under $10 | AI agent ruling is **final** | Any confidence level |\n| $10 – $50 | AI agent ruling with **80%+ confidence** | If confidence < 80%, escalate to human review |\n| Above $50 | **Always human review** | N/A — AI agent prepares case file only |",
      "line_start": 181,
      "line_end": 187
    }
  }
]
                      P-RYDE-2.1-S6.2 Section 6.2: Category Thresholds

                      来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §6.2 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

                      [
  {
    "path": "/sections/6.2",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Category Thresholds",
      "text": "| Dispute Category | Ruling Path |\n|---|---|\n| Safety incident | **Always human review** (see Section 5) |\n| Fare dispute < $10 | AI agent ruling is final |\n| Fare dispute $10 – $50 | AI agent ruling if confidence ≥ 80%, else escalate |\n| Fare dispute > $50 | Always human review |\n| Route deviation | AI agent ruling if confidence ≥ 80% and deviation ≤ 2km, else escalate |\n| Property damage (cleaning ≤ $50) | AI agent ruling if photo evidence is verifiable |\n| Property damage (repair > $50) | Always human review |\n| No-show / cancellation | AI agent ruling is final (fee is fixed at $5.00) |",
      "line_start": 189,
      "line_end": 200
    }
  }
]
                      P-RYDE-2.1-S6.3 Section 6.3: Confidence Calibration

                      来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §6.3 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

                      [
  {
    "path": "/sections/6.3",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Confidence Calibration",
      "text": "- Agent confidence is calculated based on: evidence completeness, policy clarity, precedent alignment, and party credibility scores.\n- If any party has a fraud flag ≥ 1, the confidence threshold is raised to 95% regardless of dispute value.",
      "line_start": 202,
      "line_end": 205
    }
  }
]

          "source": "surge_pricing_log"
        },
        {
          "evidence_id": "E-025",
          "fact": "Recorded fare difference is 450 cents (1650 charged minus 1200 quoted); this is not a refund award.",
          "source": "derived.fare_difference"
        },
        {
          "evidence_id": "E-026",
          "fact": "Supplied fare breakdown difference is 450 cents; surge amount difference is 450 cents; consistent with surge-only change: True.",
          "source": "derived.surge_comparison"
        }
      ],
      "policy": [
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S3.1",
          "rule": "Section 3.1: Upfront Quote Binding\n- The upfront quote presented to the rider at booking is **binding at the surge multiplier in effect at quote time** (typically 1.0x in normal conditions).\n- The quoted fare includes: base fare, distance fare, time fare, booking fee, and any applicable surge.",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §3.1"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S3.2",
          "rule": "Section 3.2: Surge Change Notification\n- If the surge multiplier **increases** between the time of quote and the time of trip start, the rider **MUST be notified** via an **in-app notification** before or at the point of pickup.\n- The notification must clearly state:\n  - The new surge multiplier.\n  - The revised estimated fare.\n  - An option to cancel without penalty.",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §3.2"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S3.3",
          "rule": "Section 3.3: Refund Eligibility\n| Scenario | Rider Notified? | Refund |\n|---|---|---|\n| Surge increases, rider notified, rider proceeds | Yes | No refund — higher fare applies |\n| Surge increases, rider **not** notified | No | **Full refund of the surge differential** (actual fare − quoted fare) |\n| Surge decreases between quote and trip start | N/A | Lower fare applies automatically (rider benefits) |\n| Surge unchanged | N/A | Quoted fare applies |",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §3.3"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S3.4",
          "rule": "Section 3.4: Surge Differential Calculation\n```\nsurge_differential = actual_fare − upfront_quote\n```\n\nWhere the difference is attributable solely to a surge multiplier change (all other fare components unchanged), the full differential is refundable if the rider was not notified.",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §3.4"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S3.5",
          "rule": "Section 3.5: Surge-Exempt Components\nThe following fare components are **exempt** from surge pricing and remain fixed regardless of multiplier:\n\n- Booking fee\n\nAll other components (base fare, distance fare, time fare) are subject to the surge multiplier.",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §3.5"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S5.1",
          "rule": "Section 5.1: Automatic Escalation\nAny dispute flagged as **safety-related** is **automatically escalated to human review**. Safety-related disputes include but are not limited to:\n\n- Reckless or dangerous driving.\n- Physical or verbal harassment.\n- Assault or threat of assault.\n- Inappropriate behavior or conduct.\n- Traffic accidents during the trip.\n- Rider or driver feeling unsafe during the trip.",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §5.1"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S5.2",
          "rule": "Section 5.2: AI Agent Limitations\n- AI agents (Rider Advocate, Driver Advocate, Judge) **MAY** gather evidence, summarize accounts, and prepare case files for human reviewers.\n- AI agents **CANNOT** issue rulings, determine fault, or recommend resolutions on safety incidents.\n- AI agents **MUST** flag any dispute that contains safety-related keywords or indicators for immediate human escalation, regardless of the dispute type selected by the filer.",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §5.2"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S5.3",
          "rule": "Section 5.3: Interim Measures\nUpon escalation, the system may apply interim measures pending human review:\n\n- Temporary suspension of the accused party's account.\n- Prevention of new trip acceptance (for drivers) or booking (for riders).\n- These measures are lifted if the human reviewer determines no safety violation occurred.",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §5.3"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S6.1",
          "rule": "Section 6.1: Monetary Thresholds\n| Dispute Value | Ruling Path | Agent Confidence Requirement |\n|---|---|---|\n| Under $10 | AI agent ruling is **final** | Any confidence level |\n| $10 – $50 | AI agent ruling with **80%+ confidence** | If confidence < 80%, escalate to human review |\n| Above $50 | **Always human review** | N/A — AI agent prepares case file only |",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §6.1"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S6.2",
          "rule": "Section 6.2: Category Thresholds\n| Dispute Category | Ruling Path |\n|---|---|\n| Safety incident | **Always human review** (see Section 5) |\n| Fare dispute < $10 | AI agent ruling is final |\n| Fare dispute $10 – $50 | AI agent ruling if confidence ≥ 80%, else escalate |\n| Fare dispute > $50 | Always human review |\n| Route deviation | AI agent ruling if confidence ≥ 80% and deviation ≤ 2km, else escalate |\n| Property damage (cleaning ≤ $50) | AI agent ruling if photo evidence is verifiable |\n| Property damage (repair > $50) | Always human review |\n| No-show / cancellation | AI agent ruling is final (fee is fixed at $5.00) |",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §6.2"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S6.3",
          "rule": "Section 6.3: Confidence Calibration\n- Agent confidence is calculated based on: evidence completeness, policy clarity, precedent alignment, and party credibility scores.\n- If any party has a fraud flag ≥ 1, the confidence threshold is raised to 95% regardless of dispute value.",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §6.3"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S7.2",
          "rule": "Section 7.2: Surge Pricing Without Rider Notification\n| Field | Value |\n|---|---|\n| **Case ID** | DISP-2026-0142 |\n| **Date** | 2026-04-03 |\n| **Dispute Type** | fare_dispute |\n| **Facts** | Rider received upfront quote of $9.50 at 1.0x surge. Surge increased to 1.4x between quote and pickup. Rider was not notified. Actual fare was $12.70 — a difference of $3.20 entirely attributable to surge differential. |\n| **Ruling** | Full refund of surge differential. Rationale: Per Section 3.3, if surge increases between quote and trip start and rider is not notified, rider is eligible for full refund of the surge differential. The $3.20 difference was solely attributable to surge multiplier change. |\n| **Refund Amount** | $3.20 |\n| **Confidence** | 96% |",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §7.2"
        }
      ]
    },
